news.Title: 10月營收利多引爆！「27檔」台股隱形冠軍
news.Content:
近期大盤歷經波段修正與萬點震盪，市場資金在多空交戰中神經緊繃。然而，當投資人目光仍緊鎖在少數高價權值與AI題材時，台股真正的基石與中流砥柱，那些在各自領域默默耕耘、市佔率雄踞全球的「隱形冠軍」，正透過最新公布的營運數字與財報交出強悍的成績單。

永捷：高機能鞋材出貨增溫　第三季EPS達0.07元

永捷（4714）公告2026年第三季合併營收達5.4億元，創歷年同期新高，年增40％；受惠國際運動品牌備貨需求，毛利率提升至26％，歸屬於母公司稅後淨利1,557萬元，EPS達0.07元，較上季轉虧為盈。10月合併營收達1.72億元，年增72.12％，續創同期新高。展望第四季，永捷持續深耕綠色環保材料，並布局折疊式顯示裝置可撓式硬塗層（HC）技術，同時推進麻豆廠反應槽擴建，規劃2027年第三季投產聚酯多元醇，擴大海外市場動能。

信立：多元應用發酵　第三季EPS達0.72元創今年新高

信立（4303）公布2026年第三季合併營收達4.02億元，季增39.81％、年增44.98％；毛利率達25％，在跨界資源整合與高附加價值產品出貨增加下，歸屬於母公司業主稅後淨利達9,487萬元，EPS達0.72元，創今年單季獲利新高。10月合併營收達1.37億元，年增96.66％。隨著集團持續深化永捷、普大應材及邁達康的策略聯盟，第四季將聚焦產銷整合與新材料開發，推動整體營運規模持續向上。

news.Title: 台股收盤／台積電跌55元！台股慘跌1165點　類股又一片慘綠
news.Content:
美股週三（11日）四大指數全面收紅，AI概念股強勢反彈，未料台股今（12）日不漲反跌，盤中賣壓持續擴大，尾盤更出現明顯殺盤。加權指數終場收在43,091.87點，大跌1,165.28點，跌幅2.63%，失守43,100點關卡，成交金額高達1兆132.93億元；代表中小型股的櫃買指數同步走弱，終場收在335.73點，下跌8.38點，跌幅2.44%，成交金額2,783.19億元。兩市合計成交金額達1兆2,916.12億元。

美股四大指數齊揚　台股開高後賣壓湧現

美股週三（11日）四大指數全面收高，AI雲端業者CoreWeave第三季營收優於預期，並上調全年財測，激勵股價飆漲近25%，帶動人工智慧（AI）概念股反彈。輝達結束連續兩個交易日跌勢，那斯達克指數上漲1.60%，費城半導體指數更勁揚5.66%，為科技股帶來反彈契機。

不過，美股科技股反彈氣勢未能延續至台股。從今日盤勢觀察，加權指數早盤一度向上反彈，但隨後賣壓逐漸湧現，指數由紅翻黑，上午11時後跌勢進一步擴大，午後更一路向下探低，終場收在43,091.87點，接近當日低檔。

台股今日成交金額突破兆元，顯示市場交投相當熱絡，但指數卻大幅下挫，反映高檔震盪加劇，資金調節壓力沉重。權王台積電（2330）下跌55元，收在2,340元，聯發科、南亞、南亞科等電子權值及記憶體股同步走弱，拖累大盤重挫逾千點，市場呈現價跌量增格局。

倫元投顧陳學進分析師認為，盤中指數一度上漲268點、上探至44525點；不過，由於美AI監管政策不確定性尚未消除，外資期貨空單居高不下、現貨一路調節動作不斷，加上AI晶片霸主黃仁勳桃色風波愈演愈烈，盤後股價應聲暴跌逾9%，以及月線與季線蓋頭反壓，仍有待時間化解，，台股連5日大漲6688點後，雖然在利空未除、以及市場信心尚未完全恢復過來之前，短線上將有震盪拉回整理的必要，且下檔於11/9日止跌長紅K棒40347~41661點區間附近有撐下，預期11月行情將可望處在於40000~45000點區間反覆震盪、個股輪動表現的機率居多，投資方向將由過去缺料漲價與題材推升，轉向基本面升級、技術門檻提高及實際訂單成長；首先是ASIC與AI伺服器，Google TPU、AWS Trainium及NVIDIA Vera Rubin陸續放量，帶動IC設計服務、伺服器組裝與高速互連需求；其次是高階PCB、CCL、ABF載板及先進封裝，隨M8/M9材料升級、晶片封裝面積擴大及製程難度提高，具備高階產品認證與實際量產訂單的廠商，將持續擴大獲利；第三是CPO、NPO及矽光子，隨800G、1.6T光通訊產品滲透率提升，高速光互連將成為降低傳輸功耗的重要技術方向；第四是半導體設備、廠務工程及矽晶圓，受惠先進製程與記憶體新廠陸續量產，帶動設備及材料需求成長，因此，面對指數處於40000~45000點區間反覆震盪的過程中，策略上除了宜把握「急漲不追、急殺不空」的原則。

台積電跌55元拖累大盤　聯發科、南亞重挫

觀察今日成交值排行前段班個股，台積電（2330）仍是市場交易焦點，終場收在2,340元，下跌55元，跌幅2.30%，成為拖累大盤的重要權值股之一。IC設計龍頭聯發科（2454）同步走弱，收在3,850元，下跌140元，跌幅3.51%；南亞（1303）跌勢更為沉重，收在293元，下跌20元，跌幅達6.39%。記

news.Title: 盤中賣壓出籠！台股終場狂瀉1165點　台積電挫跌55元

金融方面，富邦金（2881）收159元，跌0.5元；國泰金（2882）跌1元，收在112元；中信金（2891）漲0.7元，以75.4元作收；兆豐金（2886）漲0.2元，收在54.4元；華南金（2880）收50.5元平盤價；第一金（2892）收42.7元，漲0.55元；合庫金（5880）漲0.1元，以28.2元作收。

news.Title: 台股2大原因收盤慘跌1165點！台積電殺55元 AI族群全倒
news.Content:
台股3天急漲逾6千點，今（12日）短線漲多回吐，加上輝達執行長黃仁勳面臨下台危機，恐牽動台灣供應鏈後市，引發市場出現獲利了結賣壓，台股終場下跌1165.28點收在43097.87點失守44K，成交值約1兆元。權值股台積電跌55元或2.30%收在2340元，台達電跌55元4.25%收在1240元，聯發科挫低140元3.51%收在3850元。

台股開高走低，盤中一度上漲268點觸及44525.24點，但接近午盤時陸續出現賣壓，尾盤更是一路走低，資金轉入金融、電信及內需族群，電子股再成提款機，記憶體與PCB族群跌勢劇烈，欣興下跌逾8.33%收在792元，南電與景碩被打入跌停，南亞科下跌逾3%，華邦電也跌逾6%。

人工智慧與半導體族群後市存在變數，輝達執行長黃仁勳外遇共諜黃樂之後又被爆出不倫戀，與輝達醫療保健副總裁鮑威爾（Kimberly Powell）有親密關係，華爾街日報則披露，輝達董事會準備撤換黃仁勳，盤後股價應聲下殺7%。

若黃仁勳真的下台，台股將受到直接衝擊，影響股價、客戶信心和訂單能見度。另有一層擔憂，黃仁勳長期頻繁來台、與台廠互動密切，若他離開，輝達與台鏈的合作關係可能出現微妙變化，後市存在不安定因素。

知名分析師艾夫斯（Dan Ives）預估，如果黃仁勳被解職，輝達的市值可能會瞬間損失高達30%。目前輝達內部最有可能的繼任者為財務長克雷斯（Colette Kress）與超大規模與高效能運算部門的副總裁巴克（Ian Buck）其中巴克的看好度較高。

news.Title: 台積電驚傳個資外洩！駭客開賣4.6萬筆員工資料 公司緊急回應
news.Content:
暗網論壇傳出有駭客兜售4.6萬筆台積電員工個資，開價3枚比特幣（約合新台幣740萬元），並威脅1周內無人購買將全面公開。台積電今（12）日證實部分現職及離職員工資訊未經授權被置於外部網站，但強調目前無證據顯示公司內部系統遭入侵，外洩資料與某雲端服務供應商的系統服務相符，且不涉及生產與客戶機密。

根據網路流傳資料，有駭客在兩大地下論壇DarkForums、BreachForums公開拍賣疑似為台積電員工的個資，釋出名為「tsmc.txt」的樣本檔案，共包含499筆資料，每筆涵蓋19個欄位，內容涵蓋姓名、生日、職稱、國籍、身分證字號，以及住址、手機號碼、Email、銀行資訊等個資，就連緊急聯絡人的電話、住址等也都完整呈現。

面對資安疑慮，台積電說明，經內部清查後確認公司系統並未遭到入侵，這批外流的員工資料與某雲端服務供應商的系統服務資料相符，與公司晶圓生產製造及客戶相關機密資料完全無關。

台積電表示，目前已陸續通知受影響的現職及離職員工並提供必要協助，同時正與該家雲端服務供應商、相關調查機關及第三方網路安全機構密切合作，加速釐清外洩源頭並採取必要防範措施，後續將持續強化員工隱私與資訊安全防護。

news.Title: 【台股3萬8抄底大調查2】台股3天絕地反攻7檔權值股漲贏大盤！散戶「押對寶」南亞狂噴30%奪冠 台達電也成大贏家
news.Content:
台股6日盤中一度跌至3萬8字頭，不過這周台股強勢反彈，短短三個交易日從上漲約4,555點，漲幅約11.47%。回顧十大權值股同期間表現，對飆大盤為「7勝3敗」，值得注意的是，光是10大權值股在上周就狂吸23萬散戶入場，其中又以股東人數大增、大戶減少的南亞在3天反彈中內飆出三成以上漲幅，成為散戶「押對寶」的代表作之一，而漲幅超過22%的台達電也在眾多權值股中脫穎而出成為亞軍。

台股急跌期間，前十大權值股股東人數卻逆勢增加。據統計，10月30日至11月6日，十檔個股總股東人數合計淨增加23萬1,476人，其中台積電增加7萬3,812人最多，聯發科增加5萬3,716人居次，台達電、欣興及南亞也分別增加逾2.6萬人。

而以十大權值股這周3日急彈期間股價表現，則以南亞（1303）從239.5元上漲至313元，三個交易日大漲30.69%，居十檔之冠。

至於台達電（2308）則以漲幅22.75%居第二；股東人數增幅近一成的欣興（3037）則飆出漲幅18.84%，獲得大量股東進場接盤的個股紛紛繳出驚人表現。

此外，大戶撤離的台光電（2383）及聯發科（2454）也分別上漲17.80%、17.70%，均明顯優於同期大盤約11.47%的漲幅。

日月光投控（3711）則上漲17.08%，台積電（2330）上漲12.18%，同樣跑贏大盤。

值得注意的是，南亞在這波反彈中表現最為強勢，但回頭檢視10月30日至11月6日集保資料，400張以上股東人數減少5人，1,000張以上股東也減少4人，但總股東人數卻在逆勢大增2.6萬人。

換言之，南亞在股災期間大戶持股呈現調節，股價卻在隨後三個交易日強勢反彈逾三成，顯示不少散戶在大戶出脫的谷底「押對寶」。

不過當然也有部分個股反彈幅度未跟上大盤，如鴻海股價從上周五收盤224.5元反彈至11日的242元，三個交易日漲幅僅7.80%，不僅低於大盤，也落後多數科技權值股。

至於大戶逆勢增加的金融股，富邦金（2881）上漲7.77%、國泰金（2882）上漲6.6%，同樣未能跟上大盤，大戶避險之下反倒錯失反彈狂飆的行情。

news.Title: 【台股3萬8抄底大調查1】股災來襲「千張大戶」買什麼？聯發科、台光電大戶撤退 日月光、富邦金反成避風港
news.Content:
台股11月6日盤中一度跌破3萬8千點，市場經歷劇烈震盪，不過，從集保中心最新股權分散統計來看，這波修正期間，千張大戶布局出現明顯分歧。據統計，前十大權值股中，千張大戶逆勢增加的個股以日月光投控（3711）最明顯，單周增加7人、增幅1.65%，富邦金（2881）也增加5人、增幅0.95%；反觀聯發科（2454）、台光電（2383）等科技股，千張大戶人數減幅居前。

本次統計以10月30日、11月6日集保中心股權分散資料為基準，鎖定台積電（2330）、聯發科（2454）、台達電（2308）、鴻海（2317）、日月光投控（3711）、南亞（1303）、富邦金（2881）、國泰金（2882）、台光電（2383）及欣興（3037）等前十大權值股，分別觀察1,000張以上大戶人數及總股東人數變化，掌握市場急跌期間的股東結構變化。

台股谷底千張大戶買什麼？日月光增加7人居冠　富邦金也增5人

從千張大戶人數來看，這波台股修正期間逆勢增加的個股並不多，其中日月光投控由425人增加至432人，單周增加7人、增幅1.65%，是十檔權值股中增加最多的標的。

富邦金則由增加5人、增幅0.95%。其餘個股中，國泰金維持683人，鴻海則減少3人、減幅0.36%，顯示千張大戶在部分大型權值股及金融股的布局相對穩定。

反觀減少幅度，聯發科千張大戶減少5人、減幅2.18%，是十檔中減幅最大者；台光電減少1人、減幅1.64%，台達電則減少3人、減幅1.13%。

欣興、南亞也分別減少2人、4人，減幅為1.00%、1.01%。整體來看，千張大戶在這波修正期間，對科技股的布局相對保守，反而是日月光投控、富邦金等個股出現人數增加。

對此，凱旭投顧分析師王士維認為，大戶在股災過程相對保守觀望，但因國安基金宣示護盤，股價近期反彈相對強勢，帶動投資人心理層面信心。散戶看的是產業基本面信仰，只要股價打折，心理就會認為超跌，加上國安基金進場，所以短線超跌勢必會有反彈。

王士維也強調，外資大幅賣超過程，大戶法人有風控與年底績效壓力，逐步撤出部分科技權值股，目前國際情勢尚未明朗前，大戶靜待觀望，目前買超都鎖定ETF，也顯示外資眼中主流未完全顯現。

運達投顧分析師陳石輝也認為，大戶並不願在外資提款、接連破底的過程中強抄過去漲多的科技股，因此選擇相對漲幅小、風險低的部分科技股與金融股，寧可少賺一根漲停板也不去承擔後續的破底風險。

news.Title: 外資減碼日股、續買中長債；日人減碼海外股票
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-12 13:10:24 蔡承啟 發佈

外資3週來首度減碼日股，不過續買日本中長債。而日本投資人(日人)4週來首度減碼海外股票。

日本財務省12日公佈統計數據指出，上週(11月1-7日)外資在日本股市賣超1,052億日圓，為3週來首度減碼日股；2026年迄今(截至11月7日為止)外資買超日股的累計金額縮小至10兆7,963億日圓。

上週外資買超日本中長期債券金額為1兆3,711億日圓，連續第6週站在買方；賣超日本短期債券金額為1兆4,983億日圓，4週來第3度站在賣方。

總計外資上週流出日本金融市場的資金總額為2,324億日圓，3週來首度呈現淨流出。

上週日本投資人(日人)在海外股市賣超6,439億日圓，4週來首度減碼海外股票；2026年迄今(截至11月7日為止)日人買超海外股票的累計金額縮小至3兆734億日圓。

日人上週賣超海外中長期債券金額為5,376億日圓，8週來第7度站在賣方；買超海外短期債券金額為663億日圓，3週來第2度站在買方。

總計日人上週流出海外金融市場(=流入日本金融市場)的資金總額為1兆1,153億日圓，3週來首度呈現淨流出。

news.Title: 台積電資安風暴？驚傳近5萬筆個資遭開價740萬拍賣 官方急聲明
news.Content:
台灣資安事件連環爆，連護國神山台積電也捲入其中！有駭客在地下論壇兜售聲稱是台積電的員工個資，包含6.9GB、共4.6萬筆紀錄，開價約台幣740萬元，並威脅一周內沒賣出就全面公開。對此，台積電緊急回應，目前無證據顯示公司內部系統遭入侵，外洩資料與生產及客戶無關，研判是某雲端服務供應商的系統資料外流，已陸續通知受影響的現職與離職員工提供協助，並聯手調查機關與資安機構全力追查。

今天台積電遭爆有駭客在地下論壇點名「台積電（TSMC）」，拍賣詳細個資。賣家聲稱取得6.9GB共4.6萬筆員工紀錄，開價3 BTC，折合台幣 740萬元，還表示如果一周沒找到買家，就公開全部資料。

台積公司發現部分現職及離職員工資訊未經授權被置於外部網站，目前並無證據顯示台積公司系統遭到入侵。已知這些資訊與某雲端服務供應商之系統服務中的資料相符，且與公司生產或客戶相關資料無關。台積公司已陸續通知受影響的人員並提供其必要的協助。同時，我們正與相關雲端服務供應商、調查機關，及第三方網路安全機構密切合作以加速釐清狀況並採取必要措施。台積公司將持續致力於保護同仁隱私與維護資訊安全。

news.Title: 台股3天狂彈逾11%！它飆超過20%　勇奪績效雙冠王
news.Content:
加權指數連三日大幅反彈逾11%，重返4萬4000點關卡之上，台股受惠美國科技股反彈，加上國安基金宣示護盤加持下，投資人信心大振，買盤大舉回籠，帶動台股ETF勁揚，11/11單日漲幅前四強主動台新臺灣中小（00416A）、主動兆豐台灣豐收（00996A）、主動台新優勢成長（00987A）、主動群益核心50（00415A）等四檔台股ETF皆大漲逾5%，其中，主動台新臺灣中小（00416A）除了單日大漲5.87%高居第一外，近三日累計漲幅亦是唯一超過2成的台股ETF，奪績效雙冠王。

前波歷經AI的雜音大震盪，致台股自10月中旬歷史高點5萬點附近向下大幅回檔2成以上，科技股快速修正，許多個股投資價值浮現，台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金（00416A）經理人沈建宏表示，國安基金進場加強信心面，且融資在短時間內瘦身有成，籌碼面有利反彈。就基本面分析，CSP雲端業務持續成長強勁，算力需求暢旺，第四季仍為AI相關零組件之出貨旺季，多數個股在2027年仍有獲利翻倍成長機會，另一方面，護國神山台積電10月合併營收較去年同期大增59.7%，創下今年以來單月營收新高，強化投資人對AI需求的信心，台股後市漲升行情持續看俏，短線遇回檔皆是逢低布局良機。

長期而言，AI趨勢並未發生重大反轉，基本面強勁，沈建宏指出，AI族群2027年營運動能有望持續成長。另外，過去20年台股11月到隔年第一季上漲機率高，仍會反映隔年作夢行情，因此在系統性風險後台股無須悲觀，仍應擇優布局。跌深的中小利基股可望率先走強，操作上，應留意新題材與輪漲，看好AI供應鏈受惠如材料升級、電力革新、新設計等；光通訊供應鏈；關鍵零組件；半導體上游材料與設備；美國設廠受惠股；漲價族群如被動元件、電源IC、矽晶圓；高股息殖利率族群等。

news.Title: 台股震盪逾600點！正2 ETF規模突破3千億元大關
news.Content:
輝達執行長黃仁勳因桃色風波面臨職位保衛戰，市場關注長期夥伴台積電先進製程及CoWoS先進封裝訂單，是否受到黃仁勳去留影響，台積電12日股價表現疲軟，早盤跌40元、來到2355元，指數最低43878點，高低震盪逾600點；不過，台股自上周五6日最低下探3萬7878點、失守年線以來，漲了約6500點， 元大台灣50正2(00631L)規模正式突破3000億元大關。

聯發科、台達電12日仍持續上攻，聯發科股價突破4000元大關、漲幅一度超過3％，最高來到4120元，台達電站上1300元，最高來到1335元，指數最高來到4萬4525點。

台股本周強力反彈與資金挹注下，正2 ETF同步狂漲，帶動00631L規模成長突破3000億元，再為台股槓桿ETF創下全新里程碑。

據證交所、集保結算所數據，00631L於4月16日、6月12日規模分別突破1,000億元及2000億元，11月11日規模再突破達3185億；累積今年以來至11月6日當周，獲得2220億淨申購，投資人數同步增加35.2萬至39.1萬人。

00631L標的指數為臺灣50指數，在指數單日正向兩倍報酬操作目標下，淨值走勢與臺灣50指數高度相關，且在行情趨勢明確如波段上漲或波段下跌時，複利效果可望使00631L漲得比0050的兩倍還多，但下跌則會比0050的兩倍少。

以實際表現來看，據Lipper統計00631L成立以來至2026年10月底績效3652％，為同期間臺灣50指數含息報酬率888％的4.11倍；槓桿設計雖使00631L波動度較0050高，但同期間報酬風險比兩者均為0.95，顯示在槓桿報酬下，未過度承擔波動風險；不過，元大投信提醒，正2 ETF適合可以持續留意行情變化的投資人，操作時須謹慎評估並嚴設停損規劃。

news.Title: Advanced Micro Devices vs. Marvell Technology: Which Artificial Intelligence Stock Is a Better Buy Going into 2027?
news.Content:
The race for artificial intelligence dominance is shifting from experimental software to heavy-duty hardware. Investors deciding between Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) and Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) must determine which niche offers the better long-term return.

AMD is a direct competitor in the high-end processor market, challenging incumbents with its CPU and AI-focused GPU semiconductor chips. Marvell specializes in data infrastructure, providing the connectivity and storage solutions that keep information moving within modern data centers. Both companies are essential players in the expanding digital economy, though they serve different corners of the tech stack among semiconductor stocks .

The case for Advanced Micro Devices

AMD designs high-performance computing products for data centers, gaming, and embedded systems. It serves major hyperscale customers like Microsoft and is expanding its compute-for-equity partnership with Meta Platforms . Recently, the company secured a multiyear partnership with OpenAI to deploy its Instinct MI450 series AI accelerators in massive data center environments.

In the fiscal year ended Dec. 27, 2025, revenue reached $34.6 billion, representing growth of 34.3% compared with the prior fiscal year. This expansion helped the company achieve net income of $4.3 billion for the period. Its net margin, which measures the percentage of revenue remaining after all expenses are paid, was 12.5%.

As of its December 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was 0.1x, a metric that compares total debt to shareholder equity to show reliance on borrowed money. The current ratio, which measures the ability to pay short-term debts with liquid assets, was 2.9x. For the fiscal year ended Dec. 27, 2025, free cash flow was $6.7 billion, though stock-based compensation (SBC) represented 21.2% of operating cash flow, which inflates reported cash generation since SBC is a non-cash expense added back in the cash flow statement.

The case for Marvell Technology

Marvell Technology operates as a fabless semiconductor company, designing hardware for data centers and communications networks. Its product line includes custom chips and storage controllers for high-speed connectivity. The company serves major cloud providers and has expanded its portfolio through the acquisition of Celestial AI and an agreement to acquire Lumentum Holdings .

In its latest annual report, filed for the fiscal year (FY) ended Jan. 31, 2026, revenue reached $8.2 billion. This was a significant increase of 42.1% year over year, resulting in net income of $2.7 billion. Its net margin hit 32.6% for the period, marking a significant shift in profitability compared to the losses reported in previous fiscal years.

Story Continues

Based on its January 2026 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was 0.3x, while the current ratio was 2.0x to indicate sufficient liquidity for short-term needs. Free cash flow for the fiscal year ended Jan. 31, 2026, was $1.4 billion. Note that stock-based compensation represented 33.8% of operating cash flow.

Risk profile comparison

Advanced Micro Devices faces intense competition from Intel and Nvidia , especially following their recent strategic partnership. The company relies heavily on a limited number of manufacturing partners, creating vulnerability to supply chain disruptions. Additionally, strict government export restrictions on advanced AI chips to certain markets have resulted in inventory charges and limit future market access.

Marvell Technology contends with revenue concentration, as a significant portion of sales comes from a small group of large distributors and direct customers. Like many peers, it depends on third-party foundries in the Pacific Rim, creating risks from geopolitical tensions or regional natural disasters. The company also faces pressure from major cloud providers developing their own proprietary chips, which could reduce long-term demand for its custom products.

Valuation comparison

Based on the Forward P/E , which compares price to future earnings estimates, and the P/S ratio, Marvell Technology appears to be the more attractively valued option.

Which stock would I buy for 2027?

AMD and Marvell have become powerhouses amid the artificial intelligence boom. AMD's business is firing on all cylinders, as illustrated by its Meta partnership, announced Oct. 27, a $2.5 billion investment in Anthropic stock, and its $13.4 billion in fiscal Q3 sales, representing a 45% year-over-year increase. Even so, I would buy Marvell Technology stock going into 2027.

Because of AMD's streak of successes in the AI sector, and the recently-revealed investigation into chief rival Nvidia's CEO by that company's Board of Directors, shares of AMD have become pricey, as Wall Street shifts away from GPU market leader Nvidia. This makes Marvell stock the better value, evidenced by both its forward earnings and sales multiples.

Marvell is also delivering spectacular results. During its investor day on Oct. 6, management shared updated revenue guidance that exceeded Wall Street expectations. The company raised sales in its 2028 fiscal year, which ends Jan. 31, 2028, to $20 billion, up from its prior guidance of $18 billion, and well above the $8.2 billion generated in FY 2026. It also set a FY 2031 revenue target of $70 billion to $90 billion.

Those figures were before Marvell announced it was acquiring Lumentum, a fast-growing optical components provider seeing massive demand due to AI's need for speed. Lumentum's sales of $1.3 billion for its fiscal Q1, ended Sept. 26, represented an impressive 137% year-over-year increase. With Lumentum, Marvell is poised to deliver strong growth in the coming years.

news.Title: 黃仁勳若下台 亞股殺血海！台灣巨頭京元電子曝險36％最危險 名單一次看
news.Content:
輝達執行長黃仁勳婚外情風波擴大，除了疑似共諜黃樂（Alice Huang）之外，還有48歲的女下屬，醫療保健事業副總裁鮑威爾（Kimberly Powell），讓黃仁勳陷入下台危機。若真的遭到免職，亞洲供應鏈將面臨直接衝擊，台灣以半導體測試巨頭京元電曝險佔比最高達36%，台積電則存在19%的業務曝險，但金額最為龐大。

深層危機是台鏈友好關係遭割捨

綜合外媒報導，京元電子承接高階晶片的測試業務，去年財報顯示單一最大客戶的營收佔比達36%，雖未公開為輝達，但從法人研究報告、供應鏈與法說會內容推算，輝達扮演重要角色。

台積電也是主要受災戶，輝達為旗下最大客戶，營收佔比為19%，去年貢獻台積電新台幣7,269.74億元營收。除了京元電與台積電之外，輝達在緯創的營收佔比預估也有21%，鴻海、日月光、廣達、緯穎、景碩、欣興與和碩等供應鏈都被列入觀察。

日、韓也是海嘯第一排

國際大廠方面，日本Ibiden佔比約29%，SK海力士有27%營收依賴輝達，日本Advantest則有22%受衝擊，南韓Leeno也有17%。台廠受到衝擊的主要原因是，黃仁勳離開後輝達的股價、客戶信心和訂單能見度。

另有一層擔憂，黃仁勳長期頻繁來台、與台廠互動密切，若他離開，輝達與台鏈的合作關係可能出現微妙變化，後市存在不安定因素。輝達與黃仁勳目前並未正式說明第二段婚外情的質疑，華爾街日報則披露，輝達最快今召開董事會討論黃仁勳的去留。

黃仁勳外遇女下屬恐成壓倒駱駝的最後一根稻草，圍繞在國安、洩密、企業治理與企業倫理的質疑，董事會若沒有詳盡說明並調整公司組織，難以服眾。

news.Title: 【台股盤中】指數攻上44500點　玻纖布概念股強勢
news.Content:
（中央社記者何秀玲台北2026年11月12日電）台股今天開低震盪，盤中一度失守44000點，最低下探43878.52點，隨後翻紅，最高來到44525.24點，高低震盪逾600點。權王台積電 (2330) 一度下跌40元，盤中跌幅收斂，為2390元，下跌5元。玻纖布概念股、機器人概念股表現亮眼。

10時55分左右，加權指數為44347點，上漲90點，漲幅0.2%，成交值約新台幣5528億元。電子類股指數上漲0.1%，金融類股指數上漲0.08%，櫃買指數上漲1.9%。

權值股盤中漲跌互見，鴻海 (2317) 今天將舉行第3季法人說明會，盤中上漲1.5元至243.5元；聯發科 (2454) 上漲75元至4065元；台達電 (2308) 上漲10元至1305元；廣達 (2382) 下跌9元至289元。

玻纖布概念股盤中走強，台玻 (1802) 攻上漲停84.3元，德宏 (5475) 、富喬 (1815) 、建榮 (5340) 皆漲逾2%。

機器人概念股盤中表現活躍，彬台 (3379) 攻上漲停36.3元；大銀微系統 (4576) 一度攻上漲停213.5元，隨後打開，盤中上漲逾8%；樺漢 (6414) 、銘異 (3060) 皆上漲逾4%。

資深證券分析師簡伯儀接受中央社記者電訪表示，台股本週前3個交易日在台積電帶動下大漲，而今天盤中部分權值股拉回，櫃買指數漲勢較明顯，顯示資金開始轉向中小型股。

簡伯儀認為，輝達執行長黃仁勳的去留傳聞，可能影響台股上攻力道，不過台股整體盤面氣氛依然偏樂觀。

news.Title: 台股早盤震盪後翻紅，櫃買指數強漲逾2%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／黃冠豪】亞股早盤呈現震盪格局，韓國KOSPI指數盤上震盪，三星電子與SK海力士則維持相對強勢。三星電子盤中上漲約3.19%，SK海力士上漲約1%，顯示記憶體及半導體個股仍有買盤支撐。日本日經225指數則上漲約450點，走勢相對穩定。台股方面，昨日大漲1545點後，今日早盤呈現高檔震盪，加權指數以44180.46點開出，早盤一度下探43878.52點，隨後買盤回流，指數由黑翻紅。上午盤中最高一度來到44525.24點，回升至44400點附近，漲幅0.4%。櫃買指數表現更為強勢，盤中來到352.57點，漲幅逾2.2%，顯示中小型股資金動能優於大型權值股。

權值股方面，台積電(2330)盤中報2375元，下跌20元、跌幅0.84%，面臨短線獲利了結壓力；聯發科(2454)報4090元，上漲100元、漲幅2.51%；台達電(2308)報1320元，上漲10元。

族群方面，被動元件持續受到市場關注，國巨*(2327)、華新科(2492)及禾伸堂(3026)為盤面觀察重點，市場持續留意AI伺服器帶動高階MLCC需求的後續效應。

PCB及CCL族群則受惠AI伺服器、高速傳輸與高階交換器需求，台光電(2383)、台燿(6274)、聯茂(6213)及金像電(2368)持續受到資金關注。ABF載板方面，欣興(3037)、南電(8046)、景碩(3189)為主要觀察指標，短線需留意前一交易日大幅反彈後的獲利了結壓力。矽光子與光通訊族群方面，聯亞(3081)、上詮(3363)、華星光(4979)及波若威(3163)仍是市場關注焦點，AI資料中心高速光傳輸需求仍是中長期重要題材。

整體而言，台股今日呈現指數震盪、中小型股相對強勢的格局。加權指數能否站穩44000點，以及櫃買指數能否延續強勢，將是盤面觀察重點。尤其輝達突發人事消息，可能影響AI供應鏈短線評價，投資人應留意台積電、聯發科及PCB、ABF、矽光子族群的資金流向，避免在消息面不確定時過度追價。

news.Title: 黃仁勳再爆「小四」 台積電訂單遭殃？專家點名致命威脅不是他
news.Content:
輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳再爆第2段不倫戀，恐面臨下台危機，讓全球AI產業供應鏈繃緊神經，由於輝達是台積電的重要客戶，黃仁勳又在台灣擁有高人氣，外界關注這場高層風波是否會衝擊台灣半導體產業。不過，美國媒體《Business Insider》引述多位產業分析師指出，即使黃仁勳真的離開輝達，短期內也不太可能撼動台積電，真正值得關注的風險，反而是美國政府對大陸晶片出口管制政策的變化。

報導指出，台積電目前掌握全球超過九成最先進晶片製造，去年營收達1220億美元，輝達更是其重要客戶之一。不過，市場研究機構Counterpoint Research資深分析師威廉李（William Li）表示，先進製程晶圓的需求遠遠超過任何單一企業高層的個人影響力，目前也沒有跡象顯示輝達正在放慢腳步，或實際削減對台積電的訂單。

Gartner新興市場動態部門副總裁兼首席分析師古普塔（Gaurav Gupta）也指出，目前看不出黃仁勳風波對台積電造成實質影響，在全球AI基礎設施需求持續強勁、晶片產能供應有限的情況下，台灣半導體供應鏈在AI產業的核心地位，短期內仍難以被取代。除非後續調查影響投資人信心，或導致企業放緩AI資料中心建置，否則短期內台積電及台灣供應鏈不至於受到明顯衝擊。

分析認為，真正可能波及台灣的因素，並非黃仁勳是否下台，而是美國政府是否進一步收緊晶片出口管制，並加強查緝高階晶片違規轉運至大陸的情況。若相關政策升級，可能影響輝達營收，進而對供應鏈帶來連鎖效應。

針對此篇報導，輝達發言人表示，與台積電及其他供應鏈夥伴的合作關係一如既往地穩固。

news.Title: 《日股早盤》半導體領軍 日經漲465點；SUMCO飆
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-12 10:37:46 蔡承啟 發佈

跟隨美股昨日(11日)走揚腳步，日本半導體相關股大漲，激勵日經225指數12日續揚，早盤收盤(台北時間上午10點30分)漲0.76%或漲465.57點，暫收61,714.16點。

就類股表現來看，截至早盤收盤為止，全部33類股中、有28類股上漲，其中以化學業類股漲幅最大，其次依序為金屬製品、水產農林業和食品業。

根據MoneyDJ XQ全球贏家系統的報價顯示，截至日本股市12日早盤收盤(台北時間上午10點30分)為止，日圓相對於美元匯率升值0.08%至159.73日圓兌1美元；日圓相對於美元匯率11日貶值0.67%，連續第2個交易日走貶，盤中最低貶至159.93、創約2個月來(9月2日以來)新低水準。

就個股表現來看，NAND Flash廠鎧俠(Kioxia)早盤大漲3.54%、晶片設備巨擘東京威力科創(TEL)早盤飆漲4.39%、晶圓切割機廠DISCO早盤大漲3.28%、軟銀集團(Softbank Group)早盤大漲2.23%。

夏普(Sharp)早盤大漲2.58%。 重振液晶面板事業，夏普傳出擬將旗下生產液晶面板關鍵零組件的工廠賣給日東電工。

矽晶圓廠SUMCO早盤飆漲7.83%。 12吋矽晶圓需求旺、出貨量大增，SUMCO 5季來首度轉虧為盈，且預估12吋產品將逐漸無法滿足客戶需求，SUMCO本季有望持續呈現盈餘。

news.Title: 獨家／台積電資安風暴！暗網拍賣4.6萬筆員工個資 駭客開價 3 BTC
news.Content:
近期台灣接連爆出多起重大資安事件，許多政府機關、知名企業遭駭客攻擊，沒想到護國神山台積電，也驚傳資安危機！有駭客在地下論壇點名「台積電（TSMC）」，拍賣詳細個資。賣家聲稱取得6.9GB共4.6萬筆員工紀錄，開價3 BTC，折合台幣 740萬元，還放話若一週內沒找到買家，就公開全部資料。

昨晚各大社群平台也陸續PO出相關訊息，有網友驚呼「台灣的資安怎麼了，最近先是91APP，再來永豐銀行，現在連護國神山都守不住了嗎？有駭客在駭客論壇販售6.9GB的46000筆台積電員工資料，從駭客給的範例資料看起來還蠻真實的，不過這種個人資訊也有可還是從外包廠商或是人力銀行掉出來的，希望晶片製程這種機密的資訊要守住啊⋯⋯。」

記者昨天傍晚致電台積電公關，並依指示寫信到記者專用信箱查證此事件。今天上午公關回應表示，「台積電已掌握此情形，正與相關雲端服務供應商及調查機關密切合作，以釐清狀況並採取必要措施。我們將適時提供後續更新。」

啟動倒數計時 一週後公開資料

這起引發資安界高度關注的個資外洩事件，是有駭客在兩個地下論壇DarkForums、BreachForums，罕見直接點名台灣資安防護等級最高的台積電，公開拍賣4.6萬筆員工紀錄，起標價3 BTC，賣家還提出期限：一週內若沒有買家，將公開全部資料。

駭客為取信買家，釋出一份名為tsmc.txt的樣本檔案，其中包含499筆詳細個資，每一筆都有19個欄位，內容涵蓋姓名、生日、職稱、國籍、身分證字號、住址、手機號碼、Email、銀行資訊等，甚至連緊急聯絡人的電話、住址等個資都完整呈現。

資安專家分析，如果駭客取得台積電員工資料屬實，對詐騙集團而言，就是設計精準詐騙劇本的絕佳素材，一旦相關資料遭到不當利用，受影響的恐怕不只是員工本人，連家人及親友可能都會陷入後續的詐騙與社交工程攻擊風險。

個資一旦外流 恐淪「詐騙劇本」

例如，攻擊者可以利用員工姓名、職稱及公司資訊，假冒公司人資、主管或內部行政人員，發送看似合理的通知；也可能結合手機與 Email，進一步發動釣魚郵件、假冒企業通知或帳號驗證詐騙。

這次樣本中，另一個值得關注的欄位，就是「緊急聯絡人」。當攻擊者不只掌握員工姓名、手機及工作單位，還知道其親友的聯絡資訊，就可能利用這層關係設計更具迷惑性的詐騙。例如，假冒公司人資聯繫家屬，聲稱員工發生緊急狀況；或運用AI深偽技術假冒員工本人，向家人要求轉帳、匯款、驗證資訊及其他事項。

台積電員工情報 牽動半導體人才及商業機密

除了個人隱私及詐騙風險，這次交易還有另一個值得注意的層面，就是半導體產業的人才情報。台積電在全球半導體供應鏈中具有關鍵地位，員工的工作背景、職稱及聯絡資訊，對外界而言可能具有一定的情報價值。如果這批資料確實包含大量員工的職務及工作資訊，未來便可能被拿來進行人才搜尋、精準挖角，甚至鎖定特定人員發動社交工程攻擊。

例如，攻擊者可能先從公開資訊與外洩資料交叉比對，找出特定專業領域或職務的員工，再假冒獵才顧問、合作廠商或業界人士建立聯繫。這類攻擊未必一開始就以竊取企業機密為目的，而是先利用個人背景建立信任，再逐步誘導目標提供更多資訊，甚至取得不當的系統存取權限。

台灣資訊安全協會（TWISA）監事、竣盟科技總經理鄭加海提醒，當大量員工個資流入地下市場，真正需要警惕的，是攻擊者可能利用這些真實資訊，設計高度可信的詐騙與社交工程攻擊。「現在的詐騙，最可怕的是他可能比你想像中更了解你。」

這也是為什麼個資外洩後，真正的風險不一定立即發生。相關資訊可能在地下市場被反覆交易、複製及交叉比對，攻擊者甚至可能在數月後，才利用這些資料發動更精準的詐騙。

員工及家屬注意四大措施 降低詐騙風險

鄭加海建議，企業應儘速確認相關資料是否涉及內部員工、是否有其他敏感資訊遭到取得，並針對可能受影響的員工建立必要的風險告知與防護措施；同時檢視人事資料的存取權限、保存方式及對外傳輸管控，避免個資遭到不當取得或再次外流。

對員工及家屬而言，則應特別注意以下四點：首先，聯繫者知道你的個資，不代表對方身分可信。其次，涉及帳號、金錢或驗證碼，一律重新查證，不要直接依照電話或訊息指示操作。此外，家人也要同步提高警覺，尤其是涉及職場緊急事故、金錢或個人資料確認的要求。最後，重要帳號應啟用多因素驗證，對工作及個人重要帳號使用不同且強度足夠的密碼，並啟用多因素驗證，降低帳號遭冒用的風險。

這起事件最大的風險，是資料一旦遭到取得並流入地下市場，即使原始貼文遭到刪除，也不代表資料已經消失。地下論壇上的資料可能被買家下載、複製、轉售，甚至重新整理後散布到其他暗網、交易平台、Telegram 群組或詐騙資料庫，如果真的流入地下市場，後續可能付出的代價，恐怕難以評估。

news.Title: 外資霸菱報告罕見談台積電「難以取代」但仍有隱憂
news.Content:
成立超過263年的霸菱（Barings）全球資產管理公司今（11）日發布最新亞洲報告，罕見主動提到對台積電（2330）看法，霸菱亞洲（不含中國）股票團隊主管林素亥（SooHai Lim）表示，美期中選後市場對資料中心興建受限及AI基礎建設投資步調的擔憂升溫，台灣、南韓特別敏感。霸菱看好台積電最新財報及第四季財測顯示，先進製程需求依然強勁，但仍會審慎評估接下來個別供應商四大面向隱憂。

林素亥（SooHai Lim）表示，團隊對亞洲（不含 日本）股市仍抱持正面看法，不過近期的修正也凸顯個股精選、分散配置與評價紀律的重要性。談到美國期中選舉結果對市場的影響，他指出，市場對資料中心興建受限及AI基礎建設投資步調的擔憂升溫，其中南韓與台灣因半導體供應鏈占比較高，對此尤為敏感。林素亥強調：「後續觀察重點在於，政治上的承諾如何落實為具體政策、專案核准及客戶的支出決策。」

談到台灣市場，林素亥表示，團隊看好具備技術領先優勢、且難以被取代的企業，特別是先進半導體製造及部分相關支援技術的業者。他指出，台積電最新財報及第四季財測顯示，先進製程需求依然強勁。他說，「即便如此，我們仍會審慎評估個別供應商受到建置延遲、客戶集中度及高成長預期的影響程度，並檢視其財務體質是否穩健。」

韓記憶體二年長約不保證3風險

在南韓方面，林素亥認為，先進記憶體仍是重要的投資機會。他指出，SK海力士揭露的長期供貨協議，涵蓋其2027至2028年逾半數的產能，提高了需求的能見度。他同時提醒，這類協議雖能提供支撐，仍無法完全排除客戶需求、價格或未來新增供給變化所帶來的風險。林素亥表示，我們會以具持續性的獲利與現金創造能力評估其股價評價，並考量目前亮眼的利潤率回歸常態後，在整個景氣循環中的表現。

「建置遷移需要時間」進度放緩衝擊交貨獲利

針對AI投資主題，林素亥表示，AI的長期結構性發展機會依然可期，但投資的時間點與報酬需要更嚴謹地檢視。他指出，近期企業釋出的訊息持續顯示需求暢旺，微軟表示客戶需求已超過現有產能，同時也坦言第三方基礎建設的交付有所延遲。他說，「這些訊息雖在選舉前就已公布，無法消除新增的政策不確定性，卻說明強勁需求與建置進度放緩可能同時存在。」林素亥進一步說明，開發商可以另覓建置地點、增加電力供應，並採取措施回應在地社區的疑慮，「然而，遷移需要時間，即使當地歡迎設廠，也不代表所需的基礎建設能立即到位。」因此，他預期投資週期的步調將更不平均，供應商的交貨時程與獲利也可能因此受到影響。

亞洲看好印度、菲律賓更獲關注

林素亥表示，AI 相關股票的重新評價，也可能帶動亞洲各市場有更多資金參與。他觀察到，印度在財報季表現不俗的帶動下，重獲外資青睞；菲律賓股市則隨著油價拉回而反彈。隨著投資人在科技供應鏈之外分散布局，他認為這兩個市場可能受到更多關注。

他指出，高能源價格向來是這些經濟體的壓力來源，若能持續緩解固然是好事，但「現階段就預期企業成本或家庭消費將明顯改善，仍言之過早」。有鑑於評價水準， 林素亥表示，團隊在印度仍維持精選個股的策略，並看好菲律賓被市場忽略的消費品牌，這些企業的市場預期已處於低檔。他強調，要形成持久的資金輪動，仍需要投資人持續關注，以及獲利兌現的佐證。

對於中國市場，林素亥認為這是另一個機會來源。他指出，近期資金輪動至中國網路平台股，顯示投資人開始將目光放在AI硬體供應鏈以外的企業。他表示，團隊偏好能將創新轉化為更強的變現能力、生產力與現金創造力，且資本配置紀律嚴謹的精選企業。他說明，AI 的應用可望強化既有的廣告、電子商務及企業服務業務，但競爭與再投資需求仍是須留意的重點。

此外，林素亥指出，團隊也在部分消費、工業及醫療保健企業中看到機會，其評價已反映內需疲弱的情況。他說：「若要迎來更全面的復甦，仍須仰賴家庭信心回升，以及更多政策支持確實轉化為經濟活動的佐證。」

就產業面而言，林素亥表示，團隊看到的機會包括：競爭地位穩固、評價已足以反映 消費疲弱的消費品牌；資產品質良好、資本結構穩健的精選銀行；以及獲利動能明確的醫療保健與工業企業。他補充，不動產公司及不動產投資信託（REITs）在資產負債表健全、基本現金流穩定且評價具吸引力時，同樣值得精選布局。林素亥總結，團隊的布局策略是結合精選的結構性科技成長標的，以及區域內具韌性且評價具吸引力的企業。他說：「我們將依據訂單、獲利預期與現金流的變化，評估這波修正所創造的機會，同時對部位大小與投資組合集中度維持紀律。」

news.Title: 日產財報、財測遜 下修新車銷量預估 股價摔
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-12 10:05:44 蔡承啟 發佈

日本汽車大廠日產汽車(Nissan)今年度上半年續陷虧損、維持今年度財測預估不變，財報、財測皆遜於市場預期，且因中國市場銷量大減，日產下修今年度新車銷量預估。日產今日股價聞訊暴跌。

根據Yahoo Finance的報價顯示，截至台北時間12日上午9點50分為止，日產暴跌5.11%至263.5日圓，今年迄今日產股價累計大跌約32%。

日產汽車11日於日股盤後公布今年度上半年(2026年4-9月)財報：新車銷量雖陷入萎縮，不過受惠於匯率變動(日圓相對於美元匯率走貶)，合併營收較去年同期成長8.8%至6兆719億日圓，合併營益為800億日圓(去年同期為營損276億日圓)，合併淨損額為397億日圓(去年同期為淨損2,219億日圓)、就歷年同期來看為連續第2年陷入虧損。

日媒報導，市場原先預期日產今年度上半年純益將為193億日圓。日產公布的財報數據遜於市場預期。

日產指出，4-9月全球新車銷售量較去年同期減少4.7%至141萬輛，其中日本市場銷量成長6.3%至19.7萬輛、中國市場銷量大減15.0%至23.7萬輛、北美市場成長2.1%至64.8萬輛(美國增加5.5%至46.9萬輛)、歐洲市場減少7.9%至13.5萬輛。

4-9月日產全球產量較去年同期減少6.6%至129.8萬輛。

日產維持今年度(2026年度、2026年4月-2027年3月)財測預估不變，合併營收預估年增8.3%至13兆日圓、合併營益預估狂飆245%至2,000億日圓、合併純益預估為200億日圓(2025年度為淨損5,331億日圓)。

金融情報服務公司QUICK事前所作的調查顯示，市場原先預期日產今年度純益將為331億日圓。日產公布的預估值遜於市場預期。

日產指出，美國和日本市場的銷售持續強勁，不過中國市場除了需求低迷外，需求轉向新能源車(NEV)的速度超乎預期，加上競爭加劇，導致銷售受到的衝擊遠大於原先預估，因此今年度全球新車銷量目標自原先預估的315萬輛下修至297萬~300萬輛、將年減4.8%~5.7%。

日產將今年度中國市場銷量目標自58萬輛下修至37萬~40萬輛(將年減38.7%~43.3%)、日本市場從43萬輛上修至43.5萬輛(將年增9.0%)、北美市場從132萬輛上修至134.5萬輛(將年增4.2%)。

日產將今年度全球產量目標自280萬輛下修至265萬輛、將年減8.7%。

news.Title: 抄底族1張最高賺破百萬元！聯發科重返4字頭 分析師：目前還是買點
news.Content:
IC設計大廠聯發科（2454）昨（11）日收在3,990元後，今（12）日早盤展現強勁反彈氣勢，盤中最高衝上4,120元，大漲130元、漲幅超過3.25%，不僅重返4,000元大關，更寫下10月底以來、逾一周盤中新高價，上周進場抄底，帳上一張最高增加破百萬元，不過分析師指出，由於外資仍在調節，加上市場關注輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳動向等消息面變數，短線能否穩站「4字頭」仍待觀察，但長線基本面無虞，股價在半年線（約4,170元）以下皆為合理買點。

根據統計，聯發科上周股東人數來到81萬4,909人，較前一周股災時的76萬1,193人增加5.37萬人。若這5萬多人是在11月6日低點3,115元時進場布局，對照今日盤中最高價4,120元，1張帳上最高大賺100萬元。

針對聯發科今日強勢走高，資深台股分析師許博傑指出，這波反彈背後主要有兩大推力，第一是基本面展望明確，聯發科在先前法說會已清楚勾勒明年成長路徑，其中備受市場關注的客製化晶片（ASIC）業務，公司自估明年營收可達160億美元，符合外資與法人圈預估的高標水準，顯示長線基本面無虞。

第二則是籌碼面與市場心理的「卡位效應」。許博傑分析，由於市場預期國安基金進場護盤時，包括台積電、聯發科、鴻海、廣達、光寶科等台灣50權值股皆是重點買進標的，因此，吸引部分聰明資金領先進場卡位。觀察近期法人動向，投信已連續站在買方力挺，唯獨外資截至昨日仍在調節賣超，形成「內資買、外資賣」的土洋對作格局。

至於投資人最關心的「今日尾盤能否穩站4,000元大關」？許博傑坦言，短線盤勢受市場心理與突發消息面牽動大，例如稍晚輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳演說或相關AI消息若出現變數，整體電子權值股仍可能面臨震盪，因此難以單憑一日盤勢鐵口直斷。

不過，針對投資人的操作策略，他指出，聯發科目前的半年線位置大約落在4,170元附近，「半年線以下都是買點」，若以中長線角度布局，現階段股價在半年線之下「其實都屬於相對合理的長線買點」，建議投資人無須過度追高，可趁拉回整理時分批承接。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 【Yahoo早盤】台股多空拉鋸...一度跌378點失守4萬4！分析師黃紫東：收紅有難度
news.Content:
美股四大指數全面收紅，費半指數勁揚逾5%，台股今（12）日卻呈現震盪走勢，加權指數以44,180.46點開出、下跌76.69點，盤中紅黑交錯，早盤最多下跌378.63點，最低來到43,878.52點，一度失守4萬4千點關卡。顧德投顧分析師黃紫東表示，台股強勢反彈後，逐步接近上方套牢籌碼密集區，尤其4萬5千點附近累積不少10月進場投資人的解套賣壓，今日拉回屬於反彈過程中的正常調整，即使盤中翻紅，尾盤仍有壓回平盤的可能。

今日值班分析師：顧德投顧分析師黃紫東

黃紫東指出，台股本周強彈大致收復上周失土。另一方面，美股費半指數逐漸回穩，市場也開始從單一公司的利空，轉向觀察超微及雲端服務商自研晶片的發展機會，加上AI雲端業者CoreWeave第三季營收優於預期，並上調全年財測，激勵股價大漲近25%，帶動科技股買盤回流。

黃紫東表示，權王台積電（2330）前一交易日已明顯上漲，依他觀察，營收或財報公布、股價反應利多後，接下來兩至三個交易日常會進入修正整理，因此今日回檔仍在合理震盪範圍。外資前一交易日雖買超台積電6,000多張，但相較10月、11月以來的賣超規模，仍屬「杯水車薪」。盤中若要穩住指數，須觀察其他大型權值股能否接棒，尤其聯發科（2454）、日月光投控（3711）等個股，能否在台積電整理時提供支撐。

族群方面，黃紫東認為，PCB是近期反彈最具連動性的主軸，從上游材料的南亞（1303）、台玻（1802），到PCB廠金像電（2368）、健鼎（3044）及敬鵬（2355），均可觀察到資金輪動。今日PCB概念股能否持續穩步攻堅，將是本周下半周的重要觀察指標；已有持股者可續抱，但漲幅已大的標的不宜追高。

黃紫東預期，今日盤勢將偏向震盪整理，尾盤翻紅機率不高，但也不至於大跌，較可能在平盤下方震盪，跌幅約落在0.4%至0.5%，成交金額估介於8,000億至9,000億元。

他也提醒，下周將迎來台指期結算，外資期貨空單達約10萬口的高水位，若後續持續增加，恐對市場信心形成壓力，結算前投資人態度可能轉趨謹慎，賣壓也可能加重。操作上應依族群表現區分，對於已明顯上漲、個股走勢又缺乏同步性的族群，不宜貿然追價；相較之下，日月光投控等封測股先前遭外資調節，這波反彈幅度落後大盤、部分個股仍在打底，可留意拉回時分批低接的機會。

馮萱榕／財經特派記者，主跑財政部、電腦通路、觀光餐飲等

news.Title: 〈台股開盤〉台積電跌逾1%大盤平盤震盪 聯發科領軍ASIC、光通訊股走強
news.Content:
AI 雲端業者 CoreWeave 財報優於預期，美股四大指數11日收紅。台股今(12)日早盤以44180.46點開出，下跌76.69點，台積電跌逾1%，，聯發科、台達電逆勢上漲；光通訊、記憶體及部分PCB股也維持紅盤，指數於平盤震盪，守住44000點大關。早盤估量1.1兆元。櫃買指數上漲約1%,，資金轉入中小個股。

主要權值股漲跌互見，台積電 (2330-TW) 以2,385元開出，下跌10元，早盤跌幅擴大至約1.15%；聯發科 (2454-TW) 漲約2.32%，台達電 (2308-TW) 漲約1.74%，日月光投控 (3711-TW) 漲約0.89%。鴻海 (2317-TW) 在平盤附近震盪，廣達 (2382-TW) 則跌約3.10%。

ASIC概念股早盤走強，創意 (3443-TW) 領漲，漲約5%；世芯-KY (3661-TW) 跟進漲4%，智原 (3035-TW) 也漲約1%。

光通訊股多檔走揚，聯亞 (3081-TW) 漲約3.50%，華星光 (4979-TW) 漲約2.15%，光聖 (6442-TW) 漲約1.92%。

記憶體股以南亞科 (2408-TW) 表現較強，早盤漲約2.47%；晶豪科 (3006-TW) 漲約0.74%，華邦電 (2344-TW) 漲約0.55%。

news.Title: 台灣半導體稱霸全球！ 台積電高層曝「2奈米超狂優勢」：根本抄不來
news.Content:
台灣半導體產業協會理事長、台積電資深副總經理暨副共同營運長侯永清指出，台灣半導體稱霸全球的核心在於「全產業鏈強大生態系」與「獨特團隊合作DNA」。即使面臨地緣政治、穩定電力、少子化與人才短缺等嚴峻考勤，台灣仍以遙遙領先的技術與敏捷的產業鏈優勢，穩居全球關鍵戰略樞紐地位。

台灣晶圓與封測全球第一

回顧過去數十年的半導體產業演變，2000年時市場仍以傳統整合元件廠為主導；發展至今，系統整合公司與無廠半導體加總已占據整體市場逾七成。這意味著新一代的強烈需求多來自生態鏈的強效整合，而這正是台灣的極致強項。

在AI浪潮帶動下，半導體產業快速成長，今年全球半導體產值已超過1.6兆美元，更有機會達到1.7兆美元。目前台灣半導體產值約占國內GDP 13%，占全球整體比重約30%，出口占比更攀升至33%。從國際競爭力來看，晶圓製造與封裝測試產值均居全球第一，IC設計能力亦穩居全球第二。

侯永清強調，提到台灣半導體，大家固然會想到台積電，但包含日月光、聯發科、聯電等眾多台廠，也在各自專業領域高居全球第一。台灣半導體的成功絕非單一公司的功勞，而是過去30年來數百家產業夥伴默默耕耘、共同打造出的堅韌生態鏈。

團隊合作是台灣隱形優勢

侯永清特別指出外界常忽視的兩大關鍵優勢。以經營一座2奈米或3奈米晶圓廠為例，過程中需要使用高達2,000至3,000種化學品與材料，並包含各式儀器與設備。在台灣，供應鏈聚落緊密，從竹科到中科、南科，透過高鐵約3小時內的車程就能取得所有資源，迅速對接供應商與客戶。這種生產力與效率在國外「需耗時十幾小時甚至數天」的情境下根本無法複製。

此外，半導體產業鏈極度複雜，沒有任何一家公司能獨自包辦到底。很多人常誇台灣人聰明、努力，但台灣工程師真正的隱形優勢是「極強的 Teamwork合作能力」。相比許多鄰近或先進國家的工程師擅長單打獨鬥，台灣人懂得跨界合作，這種合作DNA才是將生態鏈做得又大又強的核心主因。

侯永清直指三大隱形壓力

儘管產業前景看好，侯永清也坦言台灣正面臨三大嚴峻挑戰：

第一，地緣政治壓力與供應鏈在地化。面對各國積極推動供應鏈在地化，單靠企業自身重新建立生態系耗時且未必成功。台灣過去的做法就是「專注於把技術做得更棒」，透過專利授權與嚴謹的NDA合作，讓外國客戶信任並依賴台灣。即使部分製造活動必須向海外延伸，也要善用全球化累積的基礎，持續強化台灣在地供應鏈。

第二，電力與 ESG綠電需求。晶圓廠除了需要充足電力，更重視電網穩定性，避免降壓或跳電導致全線報廢。同時，國際大廠對綠電的要求日益嚴苛，台灣國土面積小，如何在土地有限的條件下提供充足且穩定的綠電以符合國際客戶的 ESG 路線圖，是產業界相當棘手的課題。

第三，少子化與人才缺口。隨著生育率下降與理工人才需求擴大，台灣除了推動法規與措施吸引並留住國外優秀人才、培養跨文化管理能力外，更重要的是「善用 AI 補足人力缺口」。例如過去運作一座成熟製程晶圓廠需2,000至2,200人，透

news.Title: 台積電挫40元與ADR脫鉤 市值失守62兆元
news.Content:
受惠於CoreWeave財報亮眼與輝達止跌回穩，美股周三（11日）四大指數全面收高，費半強彈逾5.6%、台積電ADR大漲4.25%，台積電（2330）台北現股今（12）日卻開低走低，盤中最低觸及2,355元、下跌40元，市值失守62兆元大關，分析師指出，2,385元為今日多空關鍵，尾盤若能站穩，後市有望續攻歷史高點。

AI產業前景的疑慮瓦解，外加輝達（NVIDIA）在連跌2個交易日後止跌回穩，周三（11日）美股四大指數全面收高。其中，費城半導體指數更強彈5.66%，台積電ADR同步大漲16.87美元或4.25%，收在413.35美元。

但台積電ADR的強勁走勢並未激勵台北現股表現。台積電（2330）昨（11）日強勢收在2,395元後，今（12）日早盤卻開低走低，盤中最低觸及2,355元，跌40元、跌幅達1.67%。

受股價拉回影響，台積電總市值從62.1兆元滑落至61.06兆元，單日蒸發高達1.04兆元，規模相當於跌掉一家市值近兆元的「台新新光金」，也讓台積電市值再度失守62兆元大關。

針對台積電今日與ADR表現脫鉤的原因，顧德投顧分析師張家豪指出，主要源自技術面的前波反壓。台積電先前在10月22日留下一根紮實的長黑K棒，當天低點就落在2,385元，且後續也是從跌破2,385元後才正式轉弱，因此，當昨日股價強彈並站回該價位之上後，今日隨即湧現前波高檔套牢的解套賣壓。

不過，張家豪分析，2,385元將是今日盤勢的多空關鍵，若尾盤能順利站穩2,385元之上，代表多頭有能力消化賣壓，後續持續上攻挑戰歷史高點2,580至2,590元區間的機率將大幅提高；反之，若未能守穩，短線則須先回測5日均線支撐，待籌碼沉澱後再發動第二波攻勢。

針對不同資金規模的投資人，張家豪建議操作策略應有所區隔。若是定期定額與零股族，目標在於長期累積持有股數，短線漲跌並非重點，只需維持紀律、持續分批買進即可；但若是整張操作族，由於一張台積電價格高達兩百多萬元、單日價差波動大，操作上務必緊盯技術面的支撐與壓力。他建議，從前波低點一路抱上來的整張投資人，今日逢2,385元壓力區可先獲利了結一趟，待確定突破關鍵關卡並轉強後再行買回；若想進場低接，則耐心等待回測支撐有守時再勇敢布局。

news.Title: 台股早盤震盪逾500點　台積電跌40元
news.Content:
（中央社記者何秀玲台北2026年11月12日電）台股今天走勢震盪，數度翻黑翻紅，加權指數以44180.46點開出，下跌76.69點，早盤最高44427.51點，最低43878.52點，高低震盪逾500點。權王台積電 (2330) 下跌40元，為2355元。

news.Content:
09:06更新：台股開高後出現賣壓，下跌超過330點，台積電跌35元至2360元，台達電翻黑小跌15元至1280元，聯發科上漲35元至4025元撐盤，廣達暴跌逾3%。

摩爾投顧分析師林漢偉預估，台股有機會延續反彈，再創波段反彈新高，電子權值股有望持續推升指數，中小型股則要觀察AI主流股的追價買氣，今天三大關鍵包括月線攻防、反彈量能及AI主流輪動。

然而，人工智慧與半導體族群後市存在變數，輝達執行長黃仁勳外遇共諜黃樂之後又被爆出不倫戀，與輝達醫療保健副總裁鮑威爾（Kimberly Powell）有親密關係，華爾街日報則披露，輝達董事會準備撤換黃仁勳，盤後股價應聲下殺逾8%。

若黃仁勳真的下台，台股將受到直接衝擊，使市場存在觀望氣氛。知名分析師艾夫斯（Dan Ives）預估，如果黃仁勳被解職，輝達的市值可能會瞬間損失高達30%。

台股昨（11日）又大漲1545.23點，收在44257.15點，成交值8491.65億元。三大法人合計買超202.56億元。自營商買超62.57億元，投信買超147.65億元，外資及陸資賣超7.66億元。

news.Title: 搶攻邊緣AI制高點，大聯大詮鼎攜聯發科，打造終端運算與多媒體新架構
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】半導體通路商大聯大(3702)旗下詮鼎宣布攜手IC設計大廠聯發科(2454)，針對嵌入式設備兼顧運算效能、能效與長效供貨的開發短板，推出基於「MediaTek Genio智慧物聯網平台」的一站式邊緣AI解決方案，雙方透過前沿晶片技術與軟硬體生態系深度整合，搶先卡位智慧邊緣龐大商機。大聯大詮鼎指出，聯發科Genio平台採用6奈米至先進3奈米製程，功耗僅在5W至8W之間，即可提供最高超越50 TOPS的強勁AI算力與8K影音編解碼能力。透過整合聯發科第八代NPU與高頻寬記憶體支援，該方案能直接在終端設備部署自然語言問答與姿態辨識等生成式AI及機器視覺應用，無須依賴雲端資源，不僅能大幅縮短反應時間，更能有效消除資料傳輸引發的隱私與資安風險，直擊下游客戶在智慧監控與機器人領域的應用痛點。

除了晶片架構與算力的突破，一站式技術支援與生態系協同更是協助客戶產品快速量產的關鍵。大聯大詮鼎表示，透過串聯聯發科從Genio 360到旗艦級Genio Pro 5100的完整產品陣容，世平與詮鼎團隊不僅提供多作業系統支援與最長7年的系統更新保障，更能針對高密度PCB設計媒合合作模組廠，提供製造技術支援，成功打破高階邊緣AI產品的研發門檻。

展望未來，隨著邊緣AI成為全球科技大廠的長期發展戰略，具備高整合度與低功耗特性的邊緣運算方案，將成為推動通路商獲利成長的新引擎。大聯大詮鼎與聯發科強強聯手，不僅展現深耕物聯網與AI技術迭代的長期決心，更透過「詮鼎大大芯」平台將上游原廠晶片優勢與下游客戶應用場景進行深度生態系整合。

news.Title: 聯電ADR11日上漲1.04美元漲幅6.91%折台股105.68元
聯電股價腰斬後強彈 專家揭大戶持續減碼警訊
news.Content:
台股近期經歷劇烈修正，短短一個月大跌逾1萬2,000點，多檔個股股價隨之大幅回檔。其中，晶圓代工廠聯電股價自6月波段高點185.5元一路拉回，上周一度跌破90元，最低下探88.6元，近日隨台股強彈展開反攻，重新站回104元。財經專家、股人阿勳在臉書發文，分析聯電大戶持續減碼的現象。

聯電近期矽光子布局受到市場關注。市場傳出，聯電取得中際旭創及賽麗光子的光通訊晶片訂單，初期規模上看1萬片晶圓，部分特殊製程產品單價甚至可能達到傳統CMOS製程的7倍。不過，相關訂單規模及價格目前尚未獲得公司證實。

此外，聯電今年7月已宣布，與SILITH合作完成首批12吋矽光子晶圓量產交付，並計畫於2027年推出自有矽光子平台，持續布局高附加價值特殊製程市場。

營運數據方面，聯電今年營收呈現逐月走強，9月營收達253.50億元，年增27.22%，8月年增率更達30.71%，顯示近期營運表現有所改善。

不過，財經專家、股人阿勳在臉書發文指出，除了基本面及矽光子題材，聯電近期大戶持股變化也值得留意。

根據籌碼資料，聯電最近5周400張以上大戶持股比重累計變動約減少5.56%，1000張以上大戶持股比重則減少約5.58%，在營運數據改善的同時，大戶持股比重卻持續下降。股人阿勳指出，大戶減碼不代表企業基本面一定轉差，也可能是股價大幅上漲後，部分資金選擇獲利了結。

估值方面，聯電目前股價約104元，估值河流圖顯示股價位於合理價值區間，但安全邊際為負29.94%，300日均線約86.33元。股人阿勳提醒，若估值模型受到第二季異常偏高的EPS影響，可能高估企業正常化獲利能力。

至於聯電第二季獲利表現，當季EPS達3.39元，主要受到約300.5億元業外投資收益挹注，帶動稅後淨利率升至61.48%；第三季EPS則為1.32元。因此，評估聯電獲利表現時，仍須區分業外收益與本業營運成果。

news.Title: Cisco (CSCO) Is Considered a Good Investment by Brokers: Is That True?
news.Content:
The recommendations of Wall Street analysts are often relied on by investors when deciding whether to buy, sell, or hold a stock. Media reports about these brokerage-firm-employed (or sell-side) analysts changing their ratings often affect a stock's price. Do they really matter, though?

Before we discuss the reliability of brokerage recommendations and how to use them to your advantage, let's see what these Wall Street heavyweights think about Cisco Systems (CSCO).

Cisco currently has an average brokerage recommendation (ABR) of 1.80, on a scale of 1 to 5 (Strong Buy to Strong Sell), calculated based on the actual recommendations (Buy, Hold, Sell, etc.) made by 28 brokerage firms. An ABR of 1.80 approximates between Strong Buy and Buy.

Of the 28 recommendations that derive the current ABR, 16 are Strong Buy and one is Buy. Strong Buy and Buy respectively account for 57.1% and 3.6% of all recommendations.

Brokerage Recommendation Trends for CSCO

Check price target & stock forecast for Cisco here>>>

The ABR suggests buying Cisco, but making an investment decision solely on the basis of this information might not be a good idea. According to several studies, brokerage recommendations have little to no success guiding investors to choose stocks with the most potential for price appreciation.

Do you wonder why? As a result of the vested interest of brokerage firms in a stock they cover, their analysts tend to rate it with a strong positive bias. According to our research, brokerage firms assign five "Strong Buy" recommendations for every "Strong Sell" recommendation.

This means that the interests of these institutions are not always aligned with those of retail investors, giving little insight into the direction of a stock's future price movement. It would therefore be best to use this information to validate your own analysis or a tool that has proven to be highly effective at predicting stock price movements.

Zacks Rank, our proprietary stock rating tool with an impressive externally audited track record, categorizes stocks into five groups, ranging from Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) to Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell), and is an effective indicator of a stock's price performance in the near future. Therefore, using the ABR to validate the Zacks Rank could be an efficient way of making a profitable investment decision.

Zacks Rank Should Not Be Confused With ABR

Although both Zacks Rank and ABR are displayed in a range of 1--5, they are different measures altogether.

Broker recommendations are the sole basis for calculating the ABR, which is typically displayed in decimals (such as 1.28). The Zacks Rank, on the other hand, is a quantitative model designed to harness the power of earnings estimate revisions. It is displayed in whole numbers -- 1 to 5.

Story Continues

Analysts employed by brokerage firms have been and continue to be overly optimistic with their recommendations. Since the ratings issued by these analysts are more favorable than their research would support because of the vested interest of their employers, they mislead investors far more often than they guide.

In contrast, the Zacks Rank is driven by earnings estimate revisions. And near-term stock price movements are strongly correlated with trends in earnings estimate revisions, according to empirical research.

Furthermore, the different grades of the Zacks Rank are applied proportionately across all stocks for which brokerage analysts provide earnings estimates for the current year. In other words, at all times, this tool maintains a balance among the five ranks it assigns.

There is also a key difference between the ABR and Zacks Rank when it comes to freshness. When you look at the ABR, it may not be up-to-date. Nonetheless, since brokerage analysts constantly revise their earnings estimates to reflect changing business trends, and their actions get reflected in the Zacks Rank quickly enough, it is always timely in predicting future stock prices.

Should You Invest in CSCO?

Looking at the earnings estimate revisions for Cisco, the Zacks Consensus Estimate for the current year has increased 1.3% over the past month to $5.17.

Analysts' growing optimism over the company's earnings prospects, as indicated by strong agreement among them in revising EPS estimates higher, could be a legitimate reason for the stock to soar in the near term.

The size of the recent change in the consensus estimate, along with three other factors related to earnings estimates, has resulted in a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) for Cisco. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) stocks here >>>>

Therefore, the Buy-equivalent ABR for Cisco may serve as a useful guide for investors.

news.Title: Analysts Just Slashed Their Price Targets on These 5 Stocks
news.Content: Wall Street had its worst day in 19 months last Thursday, with chip stocks leading the selloff. The Nasdaq Composite fell 5.52% to 24,315.00, its biggest one-day drop since the April 2025 tariff announcement. The S&P 500 fell 4.36% to 7,353.73, erasing about $3 trillion in market value and marking its worst day since that same tariff crash. The Dow lost 3.44%. The Nasdaq is now in a correction, more than 10% below the record close it set last month. Volume was heavy: 26.9 billion shares changed hands, against a 20-session average of 17.7 billion. Fear of Tighter AI Rules Hit Chip Stocks The trigger was politics. Investors worried about tighter AI regulation after Democrats won control of Congress, including in states where opposition to new data centers has been growing. The Philadelphia SE Semiconductor index fell more than 12% in one session, its worst day since March 2020. Candidates in both parties had campaigned against AI data centers, Yahoo Finance 's Jared Blikre reported. Melissa Brown, global head of investment decision research at SimCorp, said some newly elected members of Congress and governors want to slow the pace of AI infrastructure development, and that any slowdown would raise concerns. We covered the group's earlier pullback in our list of oversold AI stocks that Wall Street analysts saw 50%+ upside in , published before the selloff. A Partial Rebound, With Rate Hikes Still in View Jed Ellerbroek, portfolio manager at Argent Capital Management, called Thursday "the capitulation phase for the data center capex beneficiary stocks" and said the size of the moves looked excessive. Chip stocks did bounce on Friday: the semiconductor index rose 4.2% and the Nasdaq gained 1.1% to 24,579.43, and the S&P 500 rose 0.32% to 7,376.86, while the Dow slipped 0.46% to 51,285.73. But the Nasdaq still posted its fourth straight weekly decline, down 3.4% for the week, while the S&P 500 fell 2.7%, its worst week since June, and the Dow fell 0.9%. Readers weighing how far the technology sector has fallen can also look at our roundup of technology stocks trading near 52-week lows that analysts favor . Through Thursday's close, the S&P 500 was still up 7.4% for 2026 and the Nasdaq up 4.6%. Friday's jobs report showed employers added 165,000 jobs in October, against 59,000 expected, and the unemployment rate fell to 4.1%. Traders expect the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates next month, following a hike in September. We shared the expanded list of Analysts Just Slashed Their Price Targets on These 10 Stocks here. You can find the top 5 stocks below. Story Continues Computer with charts Our Methodology To compile this list, we reviewed analyst ratings announced between November 1 and November 9, as reported by financial news sites. From the stocks that came up, we picked the 10 with the highest price target cuts, and ranked them in descending order of their average upside potential, as of November 9, 2026. We also list each stock's number of hedge fund holders as of Q2 2026, from our database of 1,006 hedge funds. At Insider Monkey, we are obsessed with what hedge funds do. The reason is simple: our research has shown that we can outperform the market by imitating the top stock picks of the best hedge funds. Insider Monkey's quarterly newsletter strategy selects 14 small-cap and large-cap stocks every quarter and has returned 612% since May 2014, beating its benchmark by 375 percentage points ( see more details here ). Analysts Just Slashed Their Price Targets on These 5 Stocks 5. Coinbase (NASDAQ:COIN) Average Upside Potential: 49% Number of Hedge Fund Holders: 62 Morgan Stanley analyst Michael Cyprys downgraded Coinbase to Underweight from Equal Weight on November 2 and cut his price target to $120 from $258. "Confidence in the earnings recovery has deteriorated," he wrote, since trading, which drives most of Coinbase's earnings, looks set to recover more slowly than he expected. Third-quarter revenue fell 35% from a year earlier, and October activity put fourth-quarter transaction revenue on pace to land at roughly $607 million, 11% below what analysts expected. He also cited uncertainty after a security breach at rival exchange Binance, which he said could weigh on confidence in centralized crypto platforms. He cut his 2027 revenue forecast by 28% and his 2028 forecast by 18%, lowered his adjusted EBITDA estimates by 47% and 25% for those years, and described the outlook as a less pronounced recovery than before. Coinbase shares fell about 4% that day. Cyprys still ranks Coinbase among the best-positioned crypto platforms, so his objection is about earnings and valuation, not execution. How the company is leaning on institutions as retail activity weakens is covered in our analysis of its shift toward institutional clients . 4. Arm Holdings (NASDAQ:ARM) Average Upside Potential: 52% Number of Hedge Fund Holders: 52 Barclays analyst Tom O'Malley, who keeps an Overweight rating on Arm, cut his price target to $325 from $360 on November 5. He pointed to the company's new AGI CPU, a hardware product with lower margins than licensing, which lowers his earnings estimates. TD Cowen, still at Buy, went to $250 from $350, citing progress on procurement and supply chain for the same chip. Both firms still rate the stock positively, at Overweight and Buy. The calls followed Arm's earnings, where revenue hit a record $1.44 billion. Licensing sales rose 50% to $773 million and royalty revenue rose 8% to $670 million, but the outlook failed to beat expectations, and the stock fell about 14%. Arm designs the processor architecture that other companies license, and the AGI CPU is its move into selling a chip of its own, which is why both firms are adjusting their margin and supply assumptions. Earlier this fall the stock jumped 17% after Arm set a $2 billion revenue goal. Our earlier coverage of the rally after its $2 billion revenue goal shows how sentiment has shifted since. 3. Coherent (NYSE:COHR) Average Upside Potential: 81% Number of Hedge Fund Holders: 105 Rosenblatt analyst Mike Genovese kept a Buy rating on Coherent on November 5 and cut his price target to $400 from $500. He blamed lower sector multiples rather than the business; his new target is about 26 times fiscal 2028 earnings. He sees demand as secure: calendar 2027 is essentially booked, customers are already ordering into 2028, and long-term agreements run through the end of the decade. Craig-Hallum analyst Richard Shannon also stayed at Buy that day but cut his target to $310 from $480. Both firms kept their Buy ratings, so the changes are to price targets, not to their views of the company. Coherent reported fiscal first-quarter results this week, and the cuts followed. Revenue rose 50% to $2.37 billion and second-quarter guidance ran from $2.55 billion to $2.75 billion. The stock still fell about 13% the next day. Coherent, based in Saxonburg, Pennsylvania, makes the lasers and optical components that carry data inside AI data centers, along with products for communications and industrial customers. We asked whether the shares look reasonably priced in our look at Coherent's valuation . 2. Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE) Average Upside Potential: 85% Number of Hedge Fund Holders: 111 B. Riley analyst Dave Kang downgraded Lumentum to Neutral from Buy on November 3 and cut his price target to $770 from $1,142, citing limited upside under the deal terms. Before the deal, B. Riley had named Lumentum its top AI optics pick because its capacity was sold out through 2029. Stifel made the same move that day, downgrading to Hold from Buy and lowering its target to $806 from $1,232, also over the merger terms. Both notes make the same point. Marvell's $115 billion all-stock deal to buy Lumentum gives each Lumentum share 4.5 Marvell shares at a fixed ratio, and the deal isn't expected to close until 2028. Until then, Lumentum's stock tracks Marvell's price instead of its own results. B. Riley's note put the implied value at 4.5 times Marvell's $171 share price. Marvell shareholders would own about 67% of the combined company, and the deal carries a $3.2 billion termination fee, about $35 per Lumentum share. Lumentum makes the lasers and optical parts used in AI networks. Our piece on whether its valuation can hold up as demand outruns supply looks at the company before the deal. 1. Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) Average Upside Potential: 110% Number of Hedge Fund Holders: 96 BofA analyst Vivek Arya downgraded Marvell to Neutral from Buy on November 3 and cut his price target to $225 from $400. He said the all-stock deal to buy Lumentum "comes as a considerable surprise," since an analyst day last month made no mention of a deal this large. He argues that about $1 billion of cost savings can't offset a roughly 50% rise in share count, and he flags a long stock overhang, a regulatory process in China and customer conflicts. His new target uses 20 times calendar 2028 earnings, down from 33 times, because sector multiples have contracted. TD Cowen analyst Sean O'Loughlin made the same downgrade that day, to Hold from Buy, with a target of $175 down from $350. He adds that consensus expects a larger optical market in 2027 than TD Cowen does, so if the cycle turns, Lumentum's operating leverage could worsen the dilution. Marvell designs chips that move data inside data centers. Our look at what the few analysts who won't buy it see predates the deal. The deal would give Marvell shareholders about 67% of the combined company, and it is expected to close in the first half of 2028. While we acknowledge the risk and potential of MRVL as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: Ciena's $116M Free Cash Flow: Can Cash Generation Improve in FY27?
news.Content:
Ciena Corporation CIEN generated $116 million in free cash flow during the third quarter of fiscal 2026 despite higher working capital investments to support growing customer demand. Although cash conversion declined sequentially, management highlighted an improvement from the year-ago period. The company's focus on improving operational efficiency, strengthening supply capacity and expanding profitability could support its cash generation prospects over the longer term.

During the third quarter, Ciena increased inventory levels and invested in working capital to support higher revenues. These investments came amid strong business momentum, with third-quarter revenues increasing 37% year over year to $1.67 billion. Adjusted gross margin reached 46.4%, while adjusted operating margin rose to a record 22.5%, more than doubling from the year-ago level. These improvements reflect disciplined cost management, favorable product mix and pricing discipline.

Ciena is also prioritizing capital allocation to support its expanding business. In June, the company issued five-year zero-coupon convertible debt, allowing it to retire its 5.5% interest-bearing term loan and reduce its cost of capital. The transaction also provided funding to secure supply over the next three years. Ciena ended the third quarter with $2.8 billion in cash and equivalents. Management expects fiscal 2026 capital expenditures to reach the higher end of its $250-$275 million projected range.

However, near-term cash generation could face pressure. Management expects cash from operations to decline in the fourth quarter as it makes additional investments under long-term supply agreements extending through 2029.

Looking ahead, Ciena expects fiscal 2027 revenues to increase at least 30% year over year to $8.3-$8.4 billion, with potential upside depending on supply availability. Adjusted gross margin is projected at 45%-46% or higher, while adjusted operating margin is expected between 25% and 27%.

Although management has not provided specific free cash flow guidance for fiscal 2027, the anticipated revenue growth and margin expansion suggest improving underlying cash generation potential. However, continued working capital requirements and supply-related investments could influence the pace of improvement.

Taking a Look at CIEN's Competitors

Cisco Systems CSCO is benefiting from broad demand across networking, security and collaboration. AI infrastructure orders, integrated silicon and an end-of-support refresh opportunity support a multi-year networking cycle, while newer security products and Splunk's recovery broaden the growth base. The company also retains operating leverage and continues to return cash to its shareholders. Cisco ended the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 with $15.9 billion in cash and investments and generated $5.4 billion in operating cash flow, up 27% year over year. The company returned $12.7 billion to its shareholders in fiscal 2026. For fiscal 2027, Cisco projects revenues of $72.2-$73.4 billion and non-GAAP earnings of $5.05-$5.11 per share. Hyperscaler AI infrastructure revenues are expected to reach $7.5 billion, up from approximately $4 billion in fiscal 2026.

Story Continues

Arista Networks, Inc. 's ANET sustained investment in AI infrastructure and enterprise upgrades supports demand for its high-speed Ethernet solutions. Rising Etherlink adoption, a broader AI fabric portfolio and expanding campus networking offerings strengthen its long-term growth outlook. ANET's unified software platform and automation capabilities deepen customer engagement across cloud and enterprise networks. For 2027, management projects revenue growth between 38% and 40%, translating to approximately $18.5 billion at the midpoint. ANET's AI fabrics revenues are expected to double to approximately $7 billion, while campus networking revenues are projected to increase 60% to approximately $2 billion.

CIEN's Price Performance, Valuation & Estimates

Shares of CIEN have gained 44.9% in the past year compared with the Communications - Components industry's rally of 44.3%.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

CIEN trades at a forward 12-month price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio of 23.12, slightly below the industry's 23.25.

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for CIEN's earnings for fiscal 2026 has been unchanged over the past 60 days.

Ciena stock currently has a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here .

news.Title: PPI Data in Focus
news.Content:
It's a bank holiday, as it is every November 11th, in observation of Veterans Day. (It's also "Singles Day" in China, as depicted by the four "ones" that make up 11/11; e-commerce sales from companies Alibaba BABA and JD.com JD are no longer "singled out," however, but it's a big part of quarterly growth.) But the U.S. stock markets are active today, and look to put a second-straight day in the green together.

The Dow is up +179 points at this hour, the tech (and AI)-heavy Nasdaq is +538 points, that the S&P 500 is +75 at this hour. The small-cap Russell 2000 has so far gained +27 points in today's pre-market. Into the open, however, a new 25 basis-point (bps) Fed funds rate hike is now projected by Goldman Sachs GS this morning. Goldman, like everyone else, expects a December rate hike of 25 bps on December 9th, but has now added a March hike date, as well. (Beginning next year, only six of eight FOMC meetings will include a vote to raise, lower of keep neutral the Fed funds rate, currently at +3.75-4.00%.)

The scandal at NVIDIA NVDA continues to play out, with a potential board shakeup and investigations underway regarding CEO Jensen Huang's year-long affair with a Chinese spy. But by no means is the AI trade snuffed out this morning: after a strong beat-and-raise Wednesday afternoon, CoreWeave CRWV shares are up +15% ahead of today's opening bell. Nebius NBIS, which reports before tomorrow's open, is up +12% at this hour, adding to its +60% growth year over year.

What to Expect from the Stock Market This Week

Even though we got the Consumer Price Index (CPI) numbers yesterday — the retail monthly print on inflation — we won't see the Producer Price Index (PPI) — the wholesale side of inflation — until Friday of this week. And even though there was no year-over-year CPI number (aka the "Inflation Rate") due to the U.S. government shutdown for the October 2025 figure, such will not be the case for PPI. And, be forewarned, expectations are for year-over-year PPI (aka the "Wholesale Inflation Rate") coming in hot: +6.6% — more than 3x the preferred inflation rate from the Fed.

Before this report hits the tape, on Thursday we'll see Weekly Jobless Claims, Existing Home Sales , and a plethora of speeches from current Fed members. These include Cleveland President Beth Hammack, San Francisco President Mary Daly and New York President John Williams, in addition to Fed Governor Michael Barr. They will likely discuss the ongoing "pricing-in" of pending interest rate hikes into Q1 of 2027.

Story Continues

Also Thursday, Cisco Systems CSCO will report its fiscal Q1 results after the closing bell. The networking giant, considered an AI infrastructure play, has a long, long string of modestly beating earnings expectations. For the quarter being reported, Cisco is expected to post +33% earnings growth year over year on +21.5% higher revenues.

news.Title: Dear Cisco Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for November 12
news.Content:
Cisco Systems (CSCO) is heading into a closely watched earnings event on Thursday, Nov. 12, when the networking giant is scheduled to report its first-quarter fiscal 2027 results after the market close. Investors will be looking beyond the headline numbers for signs that the company's AI-driven networking opportunity remains on track, particularly after Cisco reported strong AI infrastructure demand and raised its full-year outlook in August.

Cisco currently expects Q1 FY2027 revenue of $18.0 billion to $18.2 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $1.32 to $1.34, while full-year revenue is projected at $72.2 billion to $73.4 billion.

More News from Barchart

Billionaire Richard Branson Feels 'Embarrassed By the Billions That Tech Entrepreneurs and Hedge Fund Managers Have Spent' on 2026 Midterms

CEO Lip-Bu Tan's 150,000-Share Purchase Wasn't Enough to Stop the Slide in Intel Stock

Get exclusive insights with the FREE Barchart Brief newsletter. Subscribe now for quick, incisive midday market analysis you won't find anywhere else.

The earnings report also comes at a pivotal moment for CSCO stock. Shares have recently faced pressure after Morgan Stanley downgraded Cisco to "Equal-weight" from "Overweight" and cut its price target to $120 from $135, citing pull-forward risks from planned price increases and potential gross-margin pressure from a growing mix of lower-margin hyperscaler hardware.

With Wall Street still broadly bullish but expectations elevated, Cisco's latest results and management commentary could provide an important catalyst for the stock.

About Cisco Stock

Cisco Systems is a global technology company headquartered in San Jose, California, that develops networking hardware, cybersecurity, collaboration, observability, and AI-driven infrastructure solutions for enterprises, governments, and service providers. The company has evolved from its networking roots into a leading provider of secure connectivity and AI-era digital infrastructure, with a growing focus on software and subscription-based services. Cisco has a market cap of $388.9 billion, making it one of the world's largest technology companies.

Cisco Systems has delivered strong gains over the longer term, but the stock has come under significant pressure ahead of its fiscal first-quarter earnings report on Nov. 12. CSCO has returned 40% over the past year and gained 30% year-to-date (YTD), reflecting investor optimism around the company's growing exposure to AI infrastructure, hyperscale customers, and data center networking. However, the recent trend has been much weaker, with the stock down 15% over the past month as investors have become increasingly concerned about valuation, AI-related gross-margin pressure, and whether strong expectations are already reflected in the share price.

Story Continues

Moreover, the selling intensified last week. Cisco shares slumped 7.6% on Nov. 5 after Morgan Stanley downgraded the stock and reduced its price target to $120 from $135. The firm argued that Cisco's strong rally had reduced the room for further upside and highlighted the risk that customers could pull forward orders ahead of planned price increases. Morgan Stanley also warned that Cisco's growing mix of lower-margin hardware sold to hyperscalers could weigh on gross margins as the company expands its AI infrastructure business. The stock then fell another 2% on Nov. 6, closing at $93.85, before staging a sharp 5.1% rebound on Nov. 9 to $98.65. As of this morning's trading, CSCO has risen almost 3% and is now above the $100 mark.

The rebound suggests that investors may be viewing the recent weakness as an opportunity to reassess Cisco ahead of earnings rather than abandoning the AI-networking story altogether. With the stock still substantially higher over the past year despite its recent pullback, the Nov. 12 earnings report could be critical in determining whether CSCO can resume its upward trend or remains under pressure.

The stock is currently trading at 21.65 times forward earnings, which is a modest discount to industry peers, while in terms of price-to-sales (P/S) of 5.96, the stock seems to be trading at a premium.

Q4 and FY2026 Results Set a High Bar for November Earnings

Cisco delivered a strong finish to fiscal 2026, reporting its fourth-quarter and full-year results on Aug. 12. The networking giant posted record quarterly revenue and earnings, with results exceeding the high end of its previous guidance. Q4 revenue rose 18% year-over-year (YoY) to $17.3 billion, while on a non-GAAP basis, net income increased 23% to $4.9 billion, while adjusted EPS rose 23% to $1.22 from $0.99. Its operating income climbed 38% to $4.3 billion, and the operating margin expanded to 24.7% from 21%. Operating cash flow also increased 27% YoY to $5.4 billion.

The strength was led by Cisco's product business, with product revenue increasing 24%, while services revenue was essentially flat. Networking revenue jumped 28%, Security revenue increased 14%, Collaboration rose 12%, and Observability grew 6%.

Meanwhile, Cisco's Q4 total product orders increased 35% YoY, while networking product orders surged 40%, marking the eighth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. The company also recorded $4 billion of AI infrastructure orders during Q4, bringing full-year AI infrastructure orders to $9.3 billion.

For fiscal 2026, Cisco's revenue increased 12% to $63.3 billion, while non-GAAP net income rose 13% to $17.2 billion, and adjusted EPS increased to $4.33 from $3.81. Full-year networking revenue was particularly impressive, rising 22% to $34.7 billion, while Security grew 2% to $8.2 billion, Collaboration increased 4% to $4.3 billion, and Observability rose 4% to $1.1 billion.

Furthermore, for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, management guided for revenue of $18 billion to $18.2 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $1.32 to $1.34. For the full fiscal year, Cisco expects revenue of $72.2 billion to $73.4 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $5.05 to $5.11. The company also expects $7.5 billion of AI infrastructure revenue in fiscal 2027, nearly double the roughly $4 billion delivered in fiscal 2026.

In addition, analysts are forecasting EPS of around $4.42 for fiscal 2027, a 21.4% YoY jump, and a 8.6% rise to $4.80 in 2028. The consensus EPS estimate of $1.15 for the first quarter of 2027 indicates a 42% rise YoY.

What Do Analysts Expect for CSCO Stock?

In addition to Morgan Stanley taking a neutral stance, Bernstein analyst Peter Weed also recently reiterated a "Hold" rating on CSCO stock with a $110 price target. This reflects Bernstein's cautious stance on CSCO despite the firm's recognition that networking companies stand to benefit from sustained AI infrastructure spending.

On the other hand, on Nov. 3, Bank of America Securities analyst Tal Liani maintained a "Buy" rating on Cisco Systems and a $150 price target ahead of the company's fiscal first-quarter earnings report. The unchanged target reflected the firm's continued bullish view of Cisco's AI-driven networking opportunity and long-term growth prospects.

Overall, CSCO stock has a consensus "Moderate Buy" rating. Of the 27 analysts covering the stock, 16 advise a "Strong Buy," one suggests a "Moderate Buy," and the remaining 10 analysts are on the sidelines, giving it a "Hold" rating.

CSCO's average analyst price target of $132.79 indicates an upside of 32%, while the Street-high target price of $165 suggests that the stock could rally as much as 64%.

news.Title: Will Cisco (CSCO) Beat Estimates Again in Its Next Earnings Report?
news.Content:
If you are looking for a stock that has a solid history of beating earnings estimates and is in a good position to maintain the trend in its next quarterly report, you should consider Cisco Systems (CSCO). This company, which is in the Zacks Computer - Networking industry, shows potential for another earnings beat.

This seller of routers, switches, software and services has seen a nice streak of beating earnings estimates, especially when looking at the previous two reports. The average surprise for the last two quarters was 3.10%.

For the most recent quarter, Cisco was expected to post earnings of $1.17 per share, but it reported $1.22 per share instead, representing a surprise of 4.27%. For the previous quarter, the consensus estimate was $1.04 per share, while it actually produced $1.06 per share, a surprise of 1.92%.

Price and EPS Surprise

With this earnings history in mind, recent estimates have been moving higher for Cisco. In fact, the Zacks Earnings ESP (Expected Surprise Prediction) for the company is positive, which is a great sign of an earnings beat, especially when you combine this metric with its nice Zacks Rank.

Our research shows that stocks with the combination of a positive Earnings ESP and a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) or better produce a positive surprise nearly 70% of the time. In other words, if you have 10 stocks with this combination, the number of stocks that beat the consensus estimate could be as high as seven.

The Zacks Earnings ESP compares the Most Accurate Estimate to the Zacks Consensus Estimate for the quarter; the Most Accurate Estimate is a version of the Zacks Consensus whose definition is related to change. The idea here is that analysts revising their estimates right before an earnings release have the latest information, which could potentially be more accurate than what they and others contributing to the consensus had predicted earlier.

Cisco has an Earnings ESP of +1.59% at the moment, suggesting that analysts have grown bullish on its near-term earnings potential. When you combine this positive Earnings ESP with the stock's Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), it shows that another beat is possibly around the corner. The company's next earnings report is expected to be released on November 12, 2026.

When the Earnings ESP comes up negative, investors should note that this will reduce the predictive power of the metric. But, a negative value is not indicative of a stock's earnings miss.

Many companies end up beating the consensus EPS estimate, though this is not the only reason why their shares gain. Additionally, some stocks may remain stable even if they end up missing the consensus estimate.

Story Continues

news.Title: AI Trade Comes Back Post-CoreWeave Numbers
news.Content:
Wednesday, November 11th, 2026

It's a bank holiday, as it is every November 11th, in observation of Veterans Day. (It's also "Singles Day" in China, as depicted by the four "ones" that make up 11/11; e-commerce sales from companies Alibaba BABA and JD.com JD are no longer "singled out," however, but it's a big part of quarterly growth.) But the U.S. stock markets are active today, and look to put a second-straight day in the green together.

The Dow is up +179 points at this hour, the tech (and AI)-heavy Nasdaq is +538 points, that the S&P 500 is +75 at this hour. The small-cap Russell 2000 has so far gained +27 points in today's pre-market. Into the open, however, a new 25 basis-point (bps) Fed funds rate hike is now projected by Goldman Sachs GS this morning. Goldman, like everyone else, expects a December rate hike of 25 bps on December 9th, but has now added a March hike date, as well. (Beginning next year, only six of eight FOMC meetings will include a vote to raise, lower of keep neutral the Fed funds rate, currently at +3.75-4.00%.)

The scandal at NVIDIA NVDA continues to play out, with a potential board shakeup and investigations underway regarding CEO Jensen Huang's year-long affair with a Chinese spy. But by no means is the AI trade snuffed out this morning: after a strong beat-and-raise Wednesday afternoon, CoreWeave CRWV shares are up +15% ahead of today's opening bell. Nebius NBIS, which reports before tomorrow's open, is up +12% at this hour, adding to its +60% growth year over year.

What to Expect from the Stock Market This Week

Even though we got the Consumer Price Index (CPI) numbers yesterday — the retail monthly print on inflation — we won't see the Producer Price Index (PPI) — the wholesale side of inflation — until Friday of this week. And even though there was no year-over-year CPI number (aka the "Inflation Rate") due to the U.S. government shutdown for the October 2025 figure, such will not be the case for PPI. And, be forewarned, expectations are for year-over-year PPI (aka the "Wholesale Inflation Rate") coming in hot: +6.6% — more than 3x the preferred inflation rate from the Fed.

Before this report hits the tape, on Thursday we'll see Weekly Jobless Claims , Existing Home Sales , and a plethora of speeches from current Fed members. These include Cleveland President Beth Hammack, San Francisco President Mary Daly and New York President John Williams, in addition to Fed Governor Michael Barr. They will likely discuss the ongoing "pricing-in" of pending interest rate hikes into Q1 of 2027.

Also Thursday, Cisco Systems CSCO will report its fiscal Q1 results after the closing bell. The networking giant, considered an AI infrastructure play, has a long, long string of modestly beating earnings expectations. For the quarter being reported, Cisco is expected to post +33% earnings growth year over year on +21.5% higher revenues.

news.Title: Radcom (RDCM) Surpasses Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
news.Content:
Radcom (RDCM) came out with quarterly earnings of $0.11 per share, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $0.06 per share. This compares to earnings of $0.29 per share a year ago. These figures are adjusted for non-recurring items.

This quarterly report represents an earnings surprise of +83.33%. A quarter ago, it was expected that this monitoring service for the communications industry would post earnings of $0.2 per share when it actually produced a loss of $0.09, delivering a surprise of -145%.

Over the last four quarters, the company has surpassed consensus EPS estimates three times.

Radcom, which belongs to the Zacks Computer - Networking industry, posted revenues of $14.04 million for the quarter ended September 2026, surpassing the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 3.74%. This compares to year-ago revenues of $18.39 million. The company has topped consensus revenue estimates two times over the last four quarters.

The sustainability of the stock's immediate price movement based on the recently-released numbers and future earnings expectations will mostly depend on management's commentary on the earnings call.

Radcom shares have lost about 22.6% since the beginning of the year versus the S&P 500's gain of 9.9%.

What's Next for Radcom?

While Radcom has underperformed the market so far this year, the question that comes to investors' minds is: what's next for the stock?

There are no easy answers to this key question, but one reliable measure that can help investors address this is the company's earnings outlook. Not only does this include current consensus earnings expectations for the coming quarter(s), but also how these expectations have changed lately.

Empirical research shows a strong correlation between near-term stock movements and trends in earnings estimate revisions. Investors can track such revisions by themselves or rely on a tried-and-tested rating tool like the Zacks Rank, which has an impressive track record of harnessing the power of earnings estimate revisions.

Ahead of this earnings release, the estimate revisions trend for Radcom was mixed. While the magnitude and direction of estimate revisions could change following the company's just-released earnings report, the current status translates into a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) for the stock. So, the shares are expected to perform in line with the market in the near future. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here.

It will be interesting to see how estimates for the coming quarters and the current fiscal year change in the days ahead. The current consensus EPS estimate is $0.09 on $13.6 million in revenues for the coming quarter and $0.33 on $57 million in revenues for the current fiscal year.

Investors should be mindful of the fact that the outlook for the industry can have a material impact on the performance of the stock as well. In terms of the Zacks Industry Rank, Computer - Networking is currently in the top 23% of the 250 plus Zacks industries. Our research shows that the top 50% of the Zacks-ranked industries outperform the bottom 50% by a factor of more than 2 to 1.

news.Title: Bitdeer Technologies Group (BTDR) (Q3 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: Revenue Surges 89% as AI ...
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Release Date: November 10, 2026

For the complete transcript of the earnings call, please refer to the full earnings call transcript .

Positive Points

Revenue grew 89% year-over-year to $320.7 million, with gross profit turning positive and adjusted EBITDA more than doubling quarter-over-quarter.

AI platform now represents approximately $7.6 billion of expected contracted revenue, including $4.7 billion from the Tydal lease and $2.9 billion of AI cloud backlog.

AI Cloud revenue was $20.4 million, up 46% sequentially and more than 11 times year-over-year, with 4,328 GPUs deployed at approximately 95% utilization.

Self-mining produced 3,855 Bitcoin in the quarter, up 43% sequentially, with September setting a record at 1,355 Bitcoin.

Fleet efficiency improved to 15.4 joules per terahash from 20.1 a year ago, and power cost per Bitcoin mined decreased to $36,000 from $49,000 a year ago.

Negative Points

Net loss was $125.5 million, or $0.46 per share, driven by non-cash items including $125.8 million of depreciation and amortization and a $54.6 million fair value loss on Bitcoin-denominated borrowings.

Cash and cash equivalents declined to $163.7 million from $456.8 million at the end of the second quarter, due to heavy investment in data center construction and land purchases.

Total debt increased to $1.95 billion, up approximately $107 million from the second quarter, reflecting additional Bitcoin-denominated borrowings.

Average power costs rose to $0.07 per kilowatt hour from $0.04 in the second quarter, putting pressure on margins.

Regulatory and permitting uncertainties exist, including potential slowdowns in Norway and the U.S. following midterm elections, which could delay data center approvals and increase community-related costs.

Q & A Highlights

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 9 Warning Signs with BTDR.

Is BTDR fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

Q : How should we think about AI cloud revenue ramping through 2027, given the $2.9 billion backlog and roughly $580 million of implied ARR? A : CFO Michael Potter said the company will provide 2027 guidance with its Q4 2026 earnings release. Revenue turns on as each phase is energized and delivered, and GPUs typically come online a few months after that. More specific guidance will come in the Q4 release.

Q : What is the status of Tito project financing for Phase 1, and what are the key milestones for Phase 2? A : CFO Michael Potter said Bitdeer is advancing its project financing plans. Customer Volta reportedly secured its GPU financing, removing the last major item needed to activate the letters of credit. The company believes it is on track for the December 31 Phase 1 milestone and for Phase 2, citing advanced construction, existing grid power from the site's prior Bitcoin mining use, and the strength of the LC backstop.

Story Continues

Q : How are AI cloud customer prepayments evolving, what percentage of CapEx can they fund, and how is the customer mix expected to shift? A : Founder, Chairman and CEO Jihan Wu said prepayments should remain well above 50% of related GPU deployment costs in the near future. He expects prepayment pressure to rise as capital markets tighten for new AI clouds and labs, reducing competition from players willing to build without prepayments. Bitdeer plans to focus on underserved AI labs and AI startups rather than hyperscalers, whose terms he described as less favorable.

Q : Does the current funding mix of Bitcoin sales, AI cloud prepayments and project financing suggest equity financing will be avoided in Q4 2026 or Q1 2027? A : CFO Michael Potter said the company will not rule anything out, but it wound down its ATM program at the end of Q2 and has not recently accessed the equity market. Bitdeer plans to link contracted cash flows to project financing and fund GPUs through large customer prepayments plus shorter-term financing. Equity is intended mainly for earlier-stage investments.

Q : What is the status of the Rockdale site, including interconnection rights, land and the potential transition to AI/HPC? A : CEO Jihan Wu said the acquired land is sufficient to build AI data centers at Rockdale, and the company is seeking additional grid power, with good news possible in the near future. CFO Michael Potter added that the $100 million, 200-acre transaction did not include water rights, but Bitdeer has an arrangement to get water to the site. Bitdeer now controls the interconnection and can transfer power from its existing site to the new site, and it has a formal substation-sharing agreement with SLR.

Q : How should investors think about the regulatory and permitting backdrop for converting U.S. mining sites to AI and HPC after the midterm elections? A : CEO Jihan Wu said the outlook is somewhat uncertain after the midterms, and he expects data center construction to require better arrangements with local communities on taxes and community contributions. He sees higher operating costs as fair, and said already-energized sites have an edge over the next one or two quarters as new approvals slow.

Q : What is the status of the Clarington and Fox Creek sites? A : CFO Michael Potter said there is no update on Clarington, where Bitdeer continues to pursue relief against a lawsuit it believes lacks a good basis; the current plan is Bitcoin mining there. At Fox Creek, the company continues building the power plant, expected in production mid-to-late next year, and has secured gas supplies and made electricity generation more robust for the planned 100-megawatt site.

Q : How is Bitdeer thinking about its global power footprint, including further expansion or selling powered land? A : CFO Michael Potter said Bitdeer is not looking to sell powered land, given scarcity and long-term growth plans, and can generate solid cash flow by mining Bitcoin while sites await AI conversion. He said nothing is absolute if an outsized offer emerged, but the company is comfortable with its position.

Q : How do recent Norwegian restrictions on new data center construction affect Tito and Bitdeer's other Norway site? A : CEO Jihan Wu said he expects everything in Norway to slow down, with fewer permissions and approvals, but it is too early to say data centers cannot be built there. He described AI as a fundamental next industrial revolution that Norway is unlikely to fully forgo.

Q : What is the remaining Tito construction spend, and what size financing is Bitdeer targeting? A : CFO Michael Potter said about $500 million remains to complete Tito construction across Phase 1 and Phase 2, with Phase 1 nearly complete ahead of the December 31 deadline. Bitdeer would seek at least $500 million of financing and aims to pull out more equity than it has put in, subject to market conditions.

Q : What are the target gross margin and EBITDA margin ranges for the AI cloud business once it reaches scale? A : CFO Michael Potter said Bitdeer will discuss financial targets and the model in more detail with Q4 results. Reaching scale is expected next year and will be part of 2027 guidance.

Q : How is Bitdeer approaching SealMiner production and capital allocation, including wafer availability and script mining such as Zcash? A : CEO Jihan Wu said Bitdeer will continue investing in mining expansion but slow the pace of capex next year. Wafer availability is tighter due to strong AI demand. He said script mining, including Zcash, offers higher revenue per megawatt than Bitcoin mining and Bitdeer has an edge in machines for that algorithm, so it will continue to expand there, though competition from new Zcash miner developers is emerging.

Q : Why is Malaysia advantageous for Bitdeer's AI cloud business compared with the U.S.? A : CEO Jihan Wu said Malaysia lets Bitdeer expand its cloud business on schedule despite U.S. midterm uncertainty and without depending on its own U.S. data center construction pace. He said U.S. and Asian tech companies are seeking Malaysia capacity, with strong inbound demand because U.S. data center space is hard to secure over the next year.

news.Title: 《韓股》AI帶動 KOSPI收漲2.6%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-11 16:58:43 數位內容中心 發佈

韓股今(11)日呈現開低走高態勢。韓國股市在美國10月CPI高於預期、聯準會12月可能再度升息的壓力下開低，但終場仍明顯收高。韓國KOSPI指數收於5375.36點，上漲136.23點或2.60%；韓國KOSDAQ指數收於705.10點，上漲37.49點或5.62%，盤面情緒最初由外部緊縮疑慮主導，盤中則轉為AI題材帶動的反彈走勢。

AI與半導體方面，CoreWeave第3季營收優於預期，Anthropic IPO估值上調的預期，也讓AI投資降溫疑慮暫時緩解。Samsung Electronics(005930.KS)收漲3.57%，SK Hynix(000660.KS)收漲5.36%，成為KOSPI指數的上行主力，並帶動半導體與相關供應鏈同步回溫。

news.Title: 〈陸股盤後〉午後漲幅擴大 三大指數走高
news.Content:
中國股市A股三大指數周三（11日）集體開低，早盤指數分化，滬指表現較弱，創指震盪走高漲幅擴大。AI硬體側午後繼續擴大漲幅，帶動創指很快漲超過3%。

上證綜指周三收盤漲0.46%，報3,680.64點；深證成指漲1.32%，報11,389.74點；創業板指漲3.11%，報2572.07點。

Wind統計顯示，兩市及北交所共3,537家上漲，1,824家下跌，平盤有215家。

兩市成交額為人民幣1.6763兆元，較前一交易日增加1,714億元。

申萬宏源研究所A股投資策略首席分析師傅靜濤在研報中提到，長期，A股處於「兩階段上漲之間2018年級別調整階段」；中期，防禦絕對主導的單邊調整已處於後段，隨後可能是底部主題活躍的震盪階段，這是建構「第二階段上漲」必經過程；短期，超跌反彈動力累積，資金供需平衡重建，歲末年初2027年春季行情可期，超跌反彈更早演繹也在情理中。

傅靜濤說，2027年3～4月前，可能是超跌反彈演繹，A股總體不再創新低窗口；2027年3～4月後，本輪市場調整可能來到底部區域，隨後結構性機會增加、主題活躍，新共識可能在此過程中凝聚。

2027年下半年期待「第二階段上漲」建立。2027年可能出現從資產配置環境、產業趨勢和資金供需共振逆風，轉向共振順風涇渭分明的大拐點。2027年下半年投資機會可能好於上半年，2027年投資回報可能高於2026年。

華泰證券認為後續關注：

一是增量政策落地成效，關注人民幣5,500億地方債結存限額和8,000億政策性金融工具支持項目落實成效。

二是穩市場政策傳導，國常會提出完善資本市場穩市機制，高度關注後續金融管理部門如何部署。

三是外部約束，聚焦美國期中選舉之後內政外交新變化以及中東局勢演變。

四是今年12月中共中央經濟工作會議將為明年政經大年定調，高度關注Q4高層調研和財政貨幣政策信號。

news.Title: 《台股盤後》飆漲1545點，重返44K及十日線
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-11 16:02:51 新聞中心 發佈

美股盤後CoreWeave季報優預期並化解市場對AI基建疑慮、Nasdaq盤後電子盤亦強勢上攻下，台股今(11)日由10月營收創佳績的台積電全場穩盤，加上日經225指數及韓國KOSPI指數亦穩步走高，激勵聯發科、台達電等盤初一度轉弱權值股明顯轉強，且金控股亦適時發揮助攻火力，搭配19大類股中僅觀光餐旅收跌，加權指數終場收在今日最高點44257.15點，飆漲1545.23點或3.62%，重新站上10日線並創下史上第6大收盤漲點，成交量則萎縮至8491.65億元。

美國10月消費者物價指數(CPI)比預期火熱，引發市場憂心聯準會(Fed)恐於12月升息並更積極收緊銀根，同時輝達股價連續第2個交易日下殺，導致美國四大指數10日全面收低。亞洲股市方面，因美股盤後Nasdaq電子盤走強，激勵日經225指數半導體相關股大漲、終場收漲1.31%；韓國KOSPI指數亦同步上漲2.60%。

台股今日台積電挾股利創高與10月營收年增近6成的利多題材，股價呈開高走高，終場以最高價2395元作收、上漲4.81%，收復月線。其餘電子股亦有亮眼表現，創意亮燈漲停，奇鋐、健策分別勁揚逾8%、7%，大立光、欣興、聯發科、聯電連袂走強。

從29大類股表現來看，今日以玻璃陶瓷類股表現最為突出、漲幅達9.10%，塑膠類股漲6.17%、半導體類股也勁揚4.50%，成為推升大盤的三大主力。至於弱勢族群部分，運動休閒、觀光餐旅、數位雲端、居家生活為四個下跌的類股，不過僅運動休閒跌幅逾1%表現最差。

三大法人動向方面，今日三大法人合計買超202.56億元；其中，自營商買超62.57億元，投信買超147.66億元，外資及陸資賣超7.66億元。

《陸股》滬指漲0.32%、日K連四紅；創業板指跌0.27%

《港股》恆指漲3.67% 登半年線；恆科指漲5.55%

Brian Kinstlinger: I'm curious, once it scale, what is the target gross margin and EBITDA margin range for the AI cloud business?
